item.title: 10,000 Diplomat Personal Records Leaked Over 10 Months Unbeknownst; Foreign Ministry's Slow Response (10개월간 몰랐던 외교관 신상정보 1만건 유출…외교부 늑장대응)
item.description:
The online education system server of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy, under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was hacked for about 10 months, potentially leaking up to 10,000 pieces of personal information of ministry employees and others. Criticism is mounting that the ministry's cybersecurity capabilities have been compromised, as it failed to detect the breach during its duration and belatedly notified affected staff. (외교부 산하 국립외교원의 온라인 교육 시스템 서버가 약 10개월 동안 해킹당해 외교부 직원 등 최대 1만건의 개인정보가 유출된 것으로 추정된다. 해킹이 지속되는 동안 이를 파악하지 못했고 직원들에게도 피해 사실을 뒤늦게 통보하는 등 외교부의 사이버 보안 역량에 구멍이 뚫렸다는 지적이 나오고 있다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was informed by relevant authorities in February of this year about the hacking of the National Diplomatic Academy's online education system, which had been ongoing from April last year to early February this year, and subsequently launched an investigation. The server stored names, IDs, email addresses, and encrypted passwords of individuals who had received training at the academy. Information may also have been leaked about all diplomats working at the ministry's headquarters and overseas missions, as well as National Intelligence Service agents and Ministry of National Defense attachés who received pre-deployment training. A ministry official stated on the 21st, "About 10,000 pieces of data were stored on the system," calling this "an unprecedented case" and noting that it is "not unrelated to national security." (외교부는 지난해 4월부터 올해 2월 초까지 국립외교원 온라인 교육 시스템이 해킹당한 정황을 올해 2월 관계기관으로부터 통보받고 조사에 착수했다. 서버에는 국립외교원에서 교육받은 인원의 이름과 아이디, 이메일 주소, 암호화된 비밀번호가 저장돼 있었다. 외교부 본부와 재외공관에서 일하는 외교관 전체를 비롯해 해외 파견 전 교육을 받은 국가정보원 요원이나 국방부 무관 등의 정보도 유출됐을 가능성을 배제할 수 없다. 외교부 당국자는 21일 “해당 시스템에 약 1만건의 데이터가 저장돼 있었다”며 이번 유출은 “유례가 없는 경우”이고 “국가안보와도 무관하지 않은 사안”이라고 말했다.)

The ministry is investigating the possibility that North Korean or Chinese authorities may be behind the hack, but has yet to identify the exact perpetrators. A ministry official said, "As of now, we lack sufficient technical analysis to determine the perpetrator," adding, "We are not ruling out any possibilities, including hacker organizations from other countries." The sensitive personal information of diplomats could be maliciously exploited. (외교부는 북한이나 중국 당국이 해킹의 배후에 있을 가능성도 염두에 두고 조사하고 있지만, 아직 정확한 공격 주체는 밝히지 못했다. 외교부 당국자는 “현재까지 주체를 단정할만한 기술적 분석은 부족한 상태”라며 “여타 국가 등 배후의 해커 조직을 포함해 모든 가능성을 배제하지 않고 있다”고 말했다. 외교관 등의 민감한 개인정보는 악의적으로 활용될 우려가 있다.)

The hacked system had been in operation since 2022, when in-person training became difficult due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The ministry conducted regular cybersecurity checks after its launch, but only became aware of the attack in early February this year after being notified by related agencies. A ministry official explained, "The attackers exploited an undisclosed security vulnerability (zero-day vulnerability) that even the software manufacturer was unaware of at the time, and then used normal software privileges, making it difficult to detect through conventional methods." However, even if it was a novel hacking technique, the fact that the breach was left unchecked for 10 months and the inadequate preparedness for hacking while handling sensitive personal information related to national security are likely to draw criticism. (해킹 공격을 받은 시스템은 코로나19 확산으로 대면 교육이 어려웠던 2022년부터 운영됐다. 외교부는 개통 이후 수시로 사이버 보안 점검을 했지만, 이번 공격은 올해 2월 초 관계기관의 통보를 받고서야 인지했다. 외교부 관계자는 “이번 공격은 소프트웨어 제조사도 당시 인지하지 못했던 미공개 보안취약점(제로데이 취약점)을 악용해 접속한 후 정상적인 소프트웨어 권한을 이용했기 때문에 일반적인 방법으로는 탐지가 어려웠다”고 해명했다. 하지만 신종 해킹 기법이더라도 해킹을 10개월이나 방치한 점, 국가안보와 관련한 민감한 개인 정보를 다루면서 해킹에 대한 대비가 충분치 않았다는 점은 비판을 피하기 어려워 보인다.)

The ministry has yet to determine the exact scale of the information leak and the extent of damages. It was only on the 20th, five months after the investigation began, that it first disclosed the hacking incident through a press release, and even then, it merely notified employees via the website. Individual notifications to affected employees are still being prepared. The ministry has also not clearly stated when the foreign minister and the Office of National Security at the presidential office were briefed. (외교부는 정확한 정보 유출 규모와 피해 상황도 파악하지 못하고 있다. 조사 착수 5개월 만인 지난 20일에야 해킹 피해 사실을 보도자료로 처음 공개했고, 직원들에게도 누리집을 통해 공지하는데 그쳤다. 피해 직원에 대한 개별 통보는 준비 중이다. 외교부 장관과 청와대 국가안보실 보고 시점도 명확히 밝히지 않고 있다.)

Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il said, "We take this matter seriously and will cooperate with relevant agencies to thoroughly investigate the incident," adding, "Taking this case as an opportunity, we will meticulously review our internal cybersecurity systems to address and improve deficiencies, and strengthen the related management systems." (박일 외교부 대변인은 “이번 사안을 엄중하게 인식하고 있으며, 관계기관과 협력해 사건의 철저한 규명을 위해서 노력할 것”이라며 “이번 사건을 계기로 내부 사이버 보안 체계를 정밀하게 점검해 미비점을 보완·개선하고 관련 관리시스템을 강화하겠다”고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: From real estate YouTubers to café operators... President Lee to discuss with 140 people (부동산 관련 유튜버·카페 운영진까지…이 대통령, 140명과 토론)
item.description:
A total of 140 people, including experts, influencers, and actual real estate consumers, will attend the national public debate on real estate policy presided over by President Lee Jae-myung, scheduled for the 23rd. (이재명 대통령 주재로 오는 23일 열리는 부동산 정책 국민 대토론회에 전문가와 인플루언서, 부동산 실수요자 등 140명이 참석한다.)

The presidential office announced the detailed plan for the national public debate on real estate policy on the 21st. The debate will see participation from 35 government officials, 30 experts, and 75 citizens, totaling 140 attendees. ( 청와대는 21일 부동산 정책 국민 대토론회 행사 세부 계획을 발표했다. 토론회에는 정부 관계자 35명, 전문가 30명, 국민 75명 등 모두 140명이 참석한다.)

Among the citizen participants, real estate YouTubers such as 'Pilot Who Talks About Wealth Management' (Choi Young-min), 'Chae-bu-shim' (Chae Sang-wook), and 'Urban Development Research Institute' (Kwon Gi-heon) have been listed, drawing attention. Active real estate and mom café communities, along with civic groups like People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy and the Snail Union, as well as industry stakeholders including real estate agents, construction companies, and financial firms, will also join the discussion. Twenty-nine individuals who submitted opinions through the public opinion collection website have also been invited. ( 국민 참여자 가운데는 ‘재테크 읽어주는 파일럿’(최영민), ‘채부심’(채상욱), ‘도시개발연구소’(권기헌) 등 부동산 관련 유튜버들이 이름을 올려 눈길을 끈다. 부동산 관련 논의가 활발한 부동산·맘카페 등을 비롯해 참여연대와 민달팽이유니온 등 시민단체, 공인중개사, 건설사와 금융사 등 업계 관계자들도 함께 토론한다. 국민의견수렴 누리집을 통해 의견을 낸 29명도 초청됐다.)

The expert group consists of 10 from academia, 5 journalists, and 15 from research institutes and market specialists. On the government side, attendees include Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol, Minister of Public Administration and Security Yoon Ho-jung, Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Kim Yoon-deok, and Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won. ( 전문가는 학계 10명, 언론인 5명, 연구소 및 시장전문가 15명으로 구성됐다. 정부 쪽에선 한성숙 국무총리와 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 윤호중 행정안전부 장관, 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관, 이억원 금융위원장 등이 참석한다. )

The debate will be held for 100 minutes starting at 10 a.m. After President Lee's opening remarks, the First Vice Minister of Economy and Finance will present the results of prior opinion collection, and experts will give presentations on topics of supply, finance, and taxation. Based on this, President Lee and the participants are expected to engage in free discussion. ( 토론회는 오전 10시부터 100분간 열린다. 이 대통령의 모두발언 뒤 재경부 1차관이 사전 의견 수렴 결과를 발표하고, 전문가들이 공급과 금융 세제를 주제로 발표를 진행한다. 이를 바탕으로 이 대통령과 참석자들이 자유 토론을 벌일 예정이다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Presidential Office: "It Would Be Good to Reach an Early Conclusion on Supplementary Investigation Powers… Should Reduce Confusion" (청와대 “보완수사권 조기 결론 내주면 좋을 듯…혼란 줄여야”)
item.description:
On the 21st, the presidential office commented on the issue of abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, stating, "It would be good to reach an early conclusion to reduce prolonged controversy or unnecessary confusion." (청와대가 21일 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 문제에 관해 “조기에 결론을 내 논란이 길어지거나 불필요한 혼란이 벌어지는 일을 줄이는 게 좋을 거 같다”고 말했다.)

A presidential office official told The Hankyoreh on the same day, "The decision has already been left to the ruling party, and we will respect whatever decision is made." The official added, "Regardless of what decision the ruling party makes, we need to prepare accordingly. Once a decision is made, issues that require preparation will become apparent, won't they? Preparing for that is the presidential office's main concern. The government will make those preparations." (청와대 관계자는 이날 한겨레에 “결정은 이미 여당에 맡겨져 있고, 어떤 결정을 내리든 존중할 것”이며 이렇게 말했다. 이 관계자는 “(여당에서) 어떤 결정을 내리든 간에 후속 대비를 해야 한다. 결정되는 순간 이런저런 점에서 대비해야 할 게 보일 게 아니냐”며 “그 대비를 하는 게 청와대의 주요 관심사다. 정부는 그 준비를 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Ahead of the August 17 national convention, as factional and ideological conflicts within the Democratic Party over the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers have intensified, the presidential office appears to have called for a swift conclusion. This is interpreted as reflecting concerns that prolonged internal conflict within the ruling party could blur the purpose of prosecution reform. The presidential office seems to hope this issue will be resolved before the national convention. (8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 더불어민주당에서 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 문제를 둘러싸고 당내 계파·노선 갈등이 심해지자 조속한 결론을 주문한 것으로 보인다. 여당 내부 갈등이 이어지면 검찰개혁의 취지가 흐려질 수 있다는 우려도 담긴 것으로 풀이된다. 청와대는 전당대회 전 이 문제가 매듭지어지길 바라는 기류다.)

Previously, President Lee Jae-myung stated at a press conference marking his first year in office on the 8th of last month, "While it is correct to limit the prosecution's authority, the public should not suffer harm. It is more desirable to hand the matter over to the National Assembly for sufficient discussion rather than the government insisting on a specific stance." (앞서 이재명 대통령은 지난달 8일 취임 1돌 기자회견에서 “검찰 권한을 배제해야 하는 것은 맞지만 국민이 피해를 봐서는 안 된다”며 “정부가 특정 입장을 고집하기보다 국회에 넘겨 충분히 논의하도록 하는 것이 바람직하다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Bo-mi: “The Reality of 686 Jjondae… When I Pointed Out Song Young-gil’s ‘Exceptional Candidacy,’ He Yelled at Me” (김보미 “686 꼰대의 현실…송영길 ‘예외적 출마’ 지적했더니 호통”)
item.description:
Kim Bo-mi (37), the youngest candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention leadership election, demanded an apology from Song Young-gil, claiming he publicly shouted at and berated her. When she pointed out that the party had exceptionally allowed Song, who did not meet the candidacy qualification requirements, to run, Song allegedly raised his voice, saying, “I’ve suffered so much while advocating for prosecution reform—what help have you given me?” Kim stated, “This is exactly the reality of the ‘686 jjondae’ that young people talk about,” calling it “a clear act of disrespect for my person.” (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 후보 중 가장 젊은 김보미(37) 대표 후보가 ‘송영길 후보가 자신에게 공개적으로 고함과 호통을 쳤다’며 사과를 요구했다. 민주당이 출마 자격 요건을 충족하지 못한 송 후보에게 예외적으로 출마를 허용한 걸 지적하자, 송 후보가 “내가 검찰개혁을 외치다 이렇게 고생했는데, 네가 도와준 거 있냐”며 목소리를 높였다는 것이다. 김 후보는 “이게 바로 청년들이 말하는 686 꼰대의 현실”이라며 “명백한 인격 무시 행위”라고 했다.)

On the 21st, after delivering her policy speech at a candidate consultation meeting held at the Seoul Metropolitan Council in Jung-gu, Seoul, Kim revealed this on Facebook, saying, “Ahead of my policy speech, I experienced the absurd situation of being shouted at by candidate Song.” (김 후보는 21일 서울 중구 서울시의회에서 열린 당대표 후보자 초청 간담회 정견발표 뒤 페이스북에 “정견발표를 앞두고 송 후보로부터 고함을 듣는 황당한 일을 당했다”며 이런 사실을 밝혔다.)

Kim wrote, “In a public setting, including the (Seoul Metropolitan Council) chairperson, council members, and council office staff, candidate Song shouted at me. I politely asked, ‘There are others here; if you have something to say, please call me separately.’ But the berating didn’t stop.” She added, “I clearly requested in my policy speech: apologize for shouting in front of so many people. Since you shouted publicly, I also demanded a public apology. But in the end, there was no apology.” (김 후보는 “(서울시의회) 의장님을 비롯해 의원님들, 의회 사무과 직원분들까지 함께 계신 공개된 자리에서 송 후보께서 제게 고함을 치셨다”며 “저는 ‘다른 분들도 계시니, 하실 말씀이 있으면 별도로 전화로 하시자’고 정중히 부탁드렸다. 그러나 호통은 멈추지 않았다”고 적었다. 이어 “정견발표에서 분명히 요청드렸다. 많은 분 앞에서 고함치신 것 사과해 주시라고. 공개적으로 고함치셨으니 저도 공개적으로 사과를 요구했다. 그러나 끝끝내 사과는 없었다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 17th, the Democratic Party exceptionally allowed Song, who did not meet the party constitution and rules’ qualification requirements for the national convention, to run. To stand in the convention, one must have been a party member for six months. Song had left the party in 2023 due to the ‘envelope money distribution allegations,’ was acquitted in the appeals trial, and rejoined in February this year, meaning he had not been a member for six months. At the time, Kim criticized the party’s decision on Facebook, saying, “This is no different from going to a job interview and changing the standards to accommodate an unqualified candidate. It starkly shows the ultimate unfairness that young people detest most.” (앞서 민주당은 지난 17일 당헌·당규상 전당대회 출마 자격 요건을 충족하지 못한 송 후보에 대해 예외적으로 출마를 허용했다. 전당대회에 출마하려면 입당 뒤 6개월이 지나야 하는데, 송 후보는 ‘돈봉투 살포 의혹’ 탓에 2023년 탈당했다가 항소심 무죄 판결을 받고 올해 2월 복당해 입당 6개월이 되지 않았다. 이에 당시 김 후보는 페이스북에 “입사 면접을 갔는데 자격이 안 되는 면접자를 위해 면접 기준을 바꾸겠다고 하는 것과 한 치도 다르지 않다. 청년들이 가장 혐오하는 불공정의 끝판왕을 적나라하게 보여주고 있다”며 당의 결정을 비판한 바 있다.)

On this day, Kim wrote, “My post may have been disappointing. But what I pointed out was not a person, but the ‘unfairness of the process.’ The core issue disappeared, and only shouting and scolding remained. Many people saw with their own eyes today why young people call the Democratic Party a ‘686 jjondae party.’” She added, “Young people do not stay in a party that has more certainty than questions, no listening, and only berating.” (김 후보는 이날 “제 글이 섭섭하실 수는 있다. 그러나 제가 지적한 건 사람이 아니라 ‘과정의 불공정’이었다”며 “논점은 사라지고 고함과 훈계만 남았다. 왜 청년들이 민주당을 ‘686 꼰대 정당’이라 부르는지 오늘 그 답을 많은 분이 두 눈으로 보셨다”고 적었다. 그는 “질문보다 확신이 많고, 경청은 없고 호통만 있는 정당에 청년들은 머물지 않는다”고도 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee says of Samsung union: "Claim that Honam semiconductor project is subject to dispute goes too far" (이 대통령, 삼전 노조에 “호남 반도체가 쟁의 대상 주장 지나쳐”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung commented on the Samsung Electronics enterprise-level union's announcement that it would make the government's 'Honam semiconductor megaproject' a subject of wage and collective agreement negotiations for 2027, stating, "If you approach it that way, every company's management rights would become (subject to dispute)," and said the government must clearly set standards. (이재명 대통령이 삼성전자 초기업노조가 정부의 ‘호남 반도체 메가프로젝트’를 2027년도 임금·단체협약 교섭 의제로 삼겠다고 밝힌 것에 관해 “그렇게 따지면 모든 회사의 경영권 행사가 (쟁의 대상이) 된다”며 정부가 기준을 명확히 제시해야 한다고 말했다.)

At a cabinet meeting presided over at the Blue House on the 21st, President Lee said, "Because a semiconductor plant is being built at Gwangju military airfield, the union claims it is a subject for labor-management negotiations and a target for labor disputes, and has gone to extremes, suggesting that if (the union) doesn't agree, it can't go ahead—citizens are very surprised." The enterprise-level union announced on the 13th, "Considering transfer placements, working conditions, and treatment, 84% of respondents opposed the Honam semiconductor megaproject," adding, "This project, which involves the workplaces and treatment of tens of thousands of people, must be pursued through dialogue with the union." (이 대통령은 21일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “광주 군공항에 반도체 공장을 만든다고 하니까 노조에서 노사 협상을 해야 할 대상이다, 노동쟁의 대상이 된다는 주장을 하면서 극단적으로 (노조가) 동의 안 하면 못 간다는 취지로 얘기가 나와 국민들께서 깜짝 놀라고 있다”며 이렇게 말했다. 초기업노조는 지난 13일 “전환 배치와 근로조건, 처우 등을 고려할 때 호남 반도체 메가프로젝트에 반대한다는 응답이 84%에 달했다”며 “수만명의 근무지와 처우가 걸린 이번 프로젝트는 조합과의 대화 위에서 추진되어야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "The claim that building a factory in Gwangju could lead to my own transfer, making it a labor dispute subject, is absurd. If that were the case, then—for example—selling a company could also become a dispute subject if there's a risk of the new owner being an unscrupulous employer worsening labor conditions. If you expand it this way, where does it end? I hope this can be sorted out quickly at a reasonable level." He made clear his view that Samsung Electronics' investment in the Honam semiconductor megaproject is a managerial decision and not a subject of labor disputes. (이 대통령은 “광주에 공장을 지으면 내가 혹시 전보될 수도 있으니 노동쟁의 대상이다 이런 주장 같은데, 터무니없는 주장이다”라며 “그러면 예를 들어 상속 문제도 누구한테 팔면 악덕 사업주가 돼 노동 조건을 더 악화시킬 가능성이 있다고 (쟁의 대상으로) 하면 경영권 매각도 문제가 될 것이다. 이런 식으로 확장하면 끝이 있느냐. 적정선에서 빨리 정리를 했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 삼성전자의 호남 반도체 메가프로젝트 투자는 경영상의 결정으로 쟁의 대상이 되지 않는다는 인식을 분명히 한 것이다.)

Regarding the enterprise-level union's demand for distributing bonuses based on 'n% of operating profit,' President Lee asked, "Is this truly a subject for dispute? In my opinion, it's more likely not." (이 대통령은 초기업노조가 요구한 ‘영업이익 엔(n)% 성과급 분배’를 두고도 “이게 과연 쟁의 대상이냐”며 “저 같은 경우 아닐 (가능성이) 더 높다고 생각된다”고 말했다.)

While saying it was his personal opinion, President Lee stated, "It seems the scope (of dispute subjects) is being expanded too broadly." He added, "It would be better for (the administration) to set standards in advance through enforcement decrees, presidential decrees, or enforcement regulations, as delegated by the Constitution." In response, Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon said, "(The enterprise-level union's claim) is contrary to the intent of the revised Trade Union Act." (이 대통령은 개인적인 의견이라면서도 “(쟁의 대상이) 너무 광범위하게 확장되는 것 같다”며 “(행정부가) 헌법이 위임한 대로 시행령이나 대통령령, 시행규칙 등으로 미리 (기준을) 정해놓는 게 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이에 김영훈 고용노동부 장관은 “(초기업노조의 주장은) 노조법 개정 취지에 반한다고 본다”고 답했다.)

President Lee continued, "The 'Yellow Envelope Act' expanded the scope of labor disputes, but isn't that causing conflicts in the field over the criteria? Isn't the question of whether something falls under it or not becoming a social issue, sparking disputes everywhere?" He urged, "Please have the (Ministry of Employment and Labor) organize the guidelines—equivalent to presidential decrees or enforcement regulations—before matters go to court." (이 대통령은 이어 “노란봉투법으로 노동쟁의 대상이 확대됐는데, 그 기준을 놓고 현장에서 분쟁이 발생하지 않느냐. 해당이 되는지 안 되는지가 사회적 쟁점이 돼서 온 사방에서 분쟁이 벌어지고 있지 않느냐”며 “법원으로 가기 전에 대통령령이나 시행 규칙에 해당하는 지침들을 (고용노동부가) 정리해 달라”고 주문했다.)

President Lee also pointed out the polarization issue caused by the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution. He said, "While the AI revolution is injecting new vitality into our economy, it is also rapidly deepening the shadow of K-shaped polarization. I ask you to concentrate all policy capabilities—fiscal, tax, financial, and others—on mitigating polarization." (이 대통령은 인공지능(AI) 혁명으로 인한 양극화 문제도 지적했다. 이 대통령은 “인공지능 혁명이 우리 경제의 새로운 활력을 불어넣고 있는 한편 케이(K)자형 양극화의 그늘을 너무 빠르게 키우는 측면이 있다”며 “양극화 완화에 재정, 조세, 금융 등 관련된 모든 정책 역량을 총집중해 주길 부탁드린다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the oil price ceiling system, he said, "The situation in the Middle East is worsening again. According to the original plan, by now we should have lowered it further or abolished it, but it seems we need to strengthen it instead." The oil price ceiling system is a price control measure introduced on March 13th, where the government sets an upper limit on the supply price of petroleum products by refiners to reduce consumer burden amid sharp rises in international oil prices. President Lee also instructed regarding the full labeling of GMOs (genetically modified organisms), "Please explore ways to implement it early." (석유 최고가격제와 관련해선 “중동 상황이 다시 악화되고 있다”며 “원래 계획에 의하면 지금쯤은 사실은 더 내리든지 폐지했어야 하는데 오히려 더 강화해야 될 것 같다”고 밝혔다. 석유 최고가격제는 국제유가 급등에 따른 소비자 부담을 줄이기 위해 정부가 정유사의 석유 공급가격에 상한을 설정하는 가격 통제 제도로, 지난 3월13일 도입됐다. 이 대통령은 지엠오(GMO, 유전자 변형 작물) 완전 표시제에 관해서는 “조기에 시행하는 방법을 강구해달라”고 지시했다.)

Both major labor federations immediately protested President Lee's remarks. (이 대통령의 발언에 양대 노총은 일제히 반발했다.)

The Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU) commented, "This is a very concerning perspective that outright denies the legislative intent of the revised Trade Union Act and seeks to restrict workers' legitimate exercise of rights." The Federation of Korean Trade Unions (FKTU) also criticized, "If the government tries to limit the scope of labor dispute subjects through enforcement rules or administrative guidelines, it will result in reducing the basic labor rights that the National Assembly expanded through legislation." (민주노총은 “개정 노조법의 입법 취지를 정면으로 부정하고, 노동자의 정당한 권리 행사를 제약하려는 매우 우려스러운 시각”이라고 논평했다. 한국노총도 “정부가 시행규칙이나 행정지침으로 노동쟁의 대상의 범위를 제한하려 한다면 국회가 입법으로 확대한 노동기본권을 축소하는 결과를 초래할 것”이라고 비판했다.)

By Shim Woo-sam, Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Real Estate Unearned Income Is the Biggest Culprit Undermining National Unity…Will Accelerate Supply" (이 대통령 “부동산 불로소득, 국민 통합 저해 주범…공급 속도 낼 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 21st, "Unearned income from real estate, fueled by illegal and underhanded methods, is the biggest culprit destroying fairness and common sense in our society and hindering national unity," and pledged to accelerate the expansion of supply and tax system reform. (이재명 대통령이 21일 “불법과 편법이 동원되는 부동산 불로소득은 우리 사회의 공정과 상식을 파괴하고, 국민 통합을 저해하는 가장 큰 주범”이라며 공급 확대와 조세 제도 개편에 속도를 내겠다고 말했다.)

During a cabinet meeting chaired at the presidential office, President Lee said, "Normalizing the real estate issue is essential for enabling productive reinvestment of resources, restoring social dynamism, and finding solutions to conflicts caused by polarization." He added, "To this end, the government will prepare comprehensive measures, including swift supply initiatives and practical policies for actual homebuyers." He continued, "To break free from the ruinous real estate republic and move toward housing stability for the people and productive economic development, we will humbly listen to the voices of our citizens and craft feasible solutions from them." President Lee plans to attend the "National Public Debate on Real Estate Policy" on the 23rd. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “부동산 문제를 정상화해야 자원의 생산적 재투자가 가능하고, 사회적 역동성이 복원되고, 양극화로 인한 갈등도 해결의 실마리를 찾을 수 있다”며 “정부는 이를 위해 속도감 있는 공급 대책과 더불어 현실에 부합하는 실수요자 대책을 촘촘하게 마련하겠다”고 말했다. 이어 “망국적인 부동산 공화국에서 벗어나 국민 주거 안정과 생산적인 경제 발전으로 나아가기 위해서는 우리 국민의 목소리를 겸허하게 경청하고 그 속에서 실현 가능한 대책을 만들어보겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 오는 23일 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’에 참석할 예정이다.)

Furthermore, regarding single-stock leveraged products for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which have been criticized for destabilizing the stock market, President Lee emphasized, "It may have been intended as a policy tool for exchange rate stability, but the public doesn't need to consider that aspect." He added, "From the perspective of stock market participants, the policy's inefficiencies or problems are far greater, so we must promptly and thoroughly develop supplementary measures." (아울러 이 대통령은 주식시장 불안정을 조장한다는 지적을 받는 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 상품에 대해서는 “환율 안정이라는 측면에서 정책 효과를 노렸다고 하지만, 국민이 그런 것까지 고려해야 할 건 아니다”라며 “주식 시장 참여자 입장에선 정책상의 비효율 또는 문제가 훨씬 더 크다고 보니까 보완책은 신속하게 충실하게 만들어야 한다”고 강조했다.)

In May, the government introduced these 'Samsung-SK Hynix leveraged' products to redirect investment demand flowing overseas back into the domestic stock market, aiming to revitalize capital markets and stabilize foreign exchange. However, they have faced heavy criticism for increasing stock price volatility. In response to President Lee's directive for swift supplementary measures, the Financial Services Commission, just two days later on the 16th, raised the minimum deposit from 10 million won to 30 million won and decided to accept only cash when calculating the minimum deposit. (정부는 지난 5월 국외로 빠져나가는 투자 수요를 국내 증시로 돌려 자본시장을 활성화하고 외환시장 안정 효과를 위해 ‘삼전닉스 레버리지’ 상품을 도입했으나 주가 변동성을 키운다는 비판이 높다. 금융위원회는 이 대통령이 신속한 보완 대책을 만들라고 지시한 지 이틀 만인 지난 16일 기본예탁금을 1천만원에서 3천만원으로 올리고, 기본예탁금을 산정할 때 현금만 인정하기로 했다.)

Commenting on these measures, President Lee said, "There are criticisms that this won't be enough," and reiterated his directive: "While it's difficult for policymakers to achieve perfection, carry out necessary actions swiftly and boldly." Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won responded, "We will monitor market impacts and prepare additional measures if needed." (이 대통령은 이 대책을 두고도 “그거 가지고 되겠냐는 지적이 있다”며 “정책당국 입장에서 완벽하게 하는 게 어렵지만, 신속하게 또 필요한 조치는 과감하게 하도록 하라”고 재차 지시했다. 이억원 금융위원장은 “시장 영향을 살피면서 필요한 경우에 추가 대책도 (마련)하도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji, yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Assembly Normalizes After 52 Days as Agreement on ‘Election Commission Special Counsel’ Concludes Floor Formation (‘선관위 특검’ 합의로 원구성 마무리…52일 만에 국회 정상화)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) withdrew its boycott of the National Assembly schedule on the 21st, using the agreement to handle a special counsel bill regarding the Election Commission’s ballot shortage as a catalyst, and also agreed to accept the seven standing committee chairmanships left by the ruling party. This puts the National Assembly, which had been stalled for over 50 days since the opening of the 22nd late-term session, on a path to normalization. <<> PPP Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik told reporters after a general meeting of lawmakers that day, “While our lawmakers still cannot accept and express strong rejection of the Democratic Party’s unilateral takeover of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, they have conditionally approved returning to the floor.” He added, “Starting today, our party will begin the process of appointing committee chairs.” <<> The Democratic Party on the 30th of last month unilaterally elected chairs for 11 out of 18 parliamentary committees during a plenary session, including the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. They reserved seven standing committee chairs for the PPP, specifically the committees on Land, Infrastructure and Transport; Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups; Health and Welfare; Education; Intelligence; Foreign Affairs and Unification; and Gender Equality and Family. The PPP has now decided to accept these positions. This normalizes the National Assembly, which had effectively been on a 52-day hiatus since the opening of the late-term session on May 30. <<> The PPP announced nominees for some of these chairs: Rep. Kim Seong-won for the Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups Committee; Rep. Lee Man-hee for the Health and Welfare Committee; Rep. Kim Hee-jung for the Education Committee; Rep. Lee Yang-soo for the Intelligence Committee; and Rep. Lim Lee-ja for the Gender Equality and Family Committee. Notably, Rep. Lee Yang-soo will chair the Intelligence Committee for one year, after which he will swap positions with Rep. Seo Sam-seok of the Democratic Party, chair of the Agriculture, Food, Rural Affairs, Oceans and Fisheries Committee. Reps. Kim Jung-jae and Song Seok-jun will alternately chair the Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee and the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, each serving for one year. The National Assembly will elect the chairs of these seven standing committees during a plenary session on the 23rd. <<> The PPP’s return to the Assembly was triggered by an agreement reached that day with the Democratic Party to handle a special counsel bill regarding the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections by the Election Commission. The two parties agreed to give the right to recommend the special counsel to a National Recommendation Committee, to be formed by each party selecting three members. This recommendation committee will receive three nominees each from the Korean Bar Association and the Council of Law School Deans, then, through bipartisan agreement, recommend two candidates to the president. The president will then appoint one of the two as special counsel. The scope, scale, and duration of the investigation will be agreed upon later by the ruling and opposition parties. <<> Meanwhile, it was reported that Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk expressed opposition to accepting the agreement during a closed-door general meeting, arguing that the special counsel law should be agreed upon only after clarifying the scope and targets of the investigation. However, Floor Leader Jeong insisted on fighting within the Assembly, stating, “We will negotiate clearly later,” and a majority of lawmakers reportedly agreed to ratify the special counsel agreement. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (국민의힘이 21일 선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태에 따른 특별검사 법안 합의 처리를 계기로 국회 일정 보이콧을 철회하고, 여당이 남긴 7개 국회 상임위원회 위원장 자리도 수락하기로 했다. 이로써 22대 후반기 개원 이후 50일 넘도록 멈췄던 국회는 정상화 수순을 밟게 됐다.)

item.title: President Lee's 'Mortgage Setting'...Cheong Wa Dae: "Sold at Lower Than Market Price, Forgoing Reconstruction Profits" (이 대통령 ‘근저당 설정’에…청 “시세보다 낮게, 재건축 이익도 포기”)
item.description:
Regarding the setting of a mortgage worth 1.77 billion won on the apartment President Lee Jae-myung sold, Cheong Wa Dae said on the 21st, "To show the will to normalize the real estate market, it was sold at a price lower than the market value, forgoing the expected profits from reconstruction." (청와대가 21일 이재명 대통령이 매각한 아파트에 17억7천만원의 근저당권을 설정한 것에 관해 “부동산 시장 정상화의 의지를 보이고자 시세보다도 낮게 재건축으로 기대되는 이익을 포기하고 처분했다”고 말했다.)

The Cheong Wa Dae spokesperson's office released a statement that day saying, "The title transfer was made in consideration of the buyer's circumstances, and the mortgage setting proceeded transparently based on a civil agreement between the transaction parties," adding, "The mortgage setting is for the unpaid balance that will be settled by the end of October." It further stated, "The transaction was conducted through real estate in a conventional manner," and "The claim that there was a personal connection or special relationship with the buyer is groundless." (청와대 대변인실은 이날 입장을 내어 “매수인의 사정을 배려해 등기 이전을 했으며 근저당 설정은 거래 당사자들의 민사상 합의에 따라 투명하게 진행됐다”며 “근저당 설정은 10월 말에 처리될 미지급 잔금에 대한 근저당”이라고 밝혔다. 이어 “매매는 통상적 방식으로 부동산을 통해 이뤄졌다”며 “매수인과 사적 인연이나 특수관계가 있다는 주장은 사실무근”이라고 했다.)

Cheong Wa Dae also refuted, "The designation of the sold property as a leading reconstruction district occurred in November 2024, under the previous Yoon Seok-youl administration, and at that time, the mayor of Seongnam was also from the People Power Party. Thus, claims of preferential treatment in the reconstruction designation are nonsensical." The apartment was selected as a leading district for the first-generation new town large-scale reconstruction project, with the project implementer designation notice scheduled for the end of this month. (청와대는 또한 “매도 물건의 재건축 선도지구 지정은 전임 윤석열 정부 시절인 2024년 11월이며 당시는 성남시장도 국민의힘 소속이었다”며 “따라서 재건축 지정 특혜 주장은 어불성설”이라고 반박했다. 해당 아파트는 대규모 재건축 사업인 1기 신도시 선도 지구로 선정돼 이달 말 사업시행자 지정 고시를 앞둔 상황이다.)

The apartment in Bundang-gu (exclusive area 164㎡), co-owned by President Lee and Kim Hye-kyung, had its sale contract signed on the 14th, and ownership was transferred to Mr. Kim and Mr. Jo on the 16th. The procedures, including the lifting of the mortgage, are expected to be completed around the end of October. (이 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 공동 소유했던 분당구 아파트(전용면적 164㎡)는 지난 14일 매매 계약이 체결됐고 16일 김아무개씨와 조아무개씨에게로 소유권이 이전됐다. 근저당권 해제를 포함한 관련 절차는 오는 10월 말께 마무리되는 것으로 알려졌다.)

In response, Jeong Jeom-sik, the floor leader of the People Power Party, criticized it as "a sneaky expedient circumventing loan regulations." Lee Jun-seok, the leader of the Reform Party, also raised suspicions on Facebook, saying, "For ordinary people, bank loans are virtually blocked, but someone bought a house with informal private financing. Why did they find a buyer with such complicated conditions? Is it an acquaintance?" (이에 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 “대출 규제를 우회하는 편법 꼼수”라고 비판했다. 이준석 개혁신당 대표도 페이스북에 “일반인은 은행권 대출이 사실상 막혀버렸는데 누구는 편법 사금융으로 집을 샀다”며 “왜 하필 그런 복잡한 조건을 가진 매수자를 찾은 것인가? 지인인가?”라고 의혹을 제기했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Claims "President Used Mortgage Gimmick to Sell"… Presidential Office Says "No Personal Connection with Buyer" (국힘 “대통령이 근저당 꼼수 매도”…청와대 “매수인과 사적 인연 없다”)
item.description:
Regarding President Lee Jae-myung's recent sale of an apartment, where a 1.77 billion won mortgage was set with the buyers as debtors, the conservative opposition party on the 21st collectively criticized it as "a trick to bypass lending regulations." Experts pointed out that "while it's not illegal or improper, it's not a typical transaction method." The presidential office stated, "The mortgage was set transparently based on a civil agreement between the transaction parties." (이재명 대통령이 최근 매각한 아파트의 매수인들을 채무자로 해 17억7천만원의 근저당권을 설정한 것과 관련해 보수 야권이 21일 “대출 규제를 우회하는 꼼수”라고 일제히 비판했다. 전문가들은 “불법·편법은 아니지만 일반적인 거래 방식은 아니”라고 지적했다. 청와대는 “근저당 설정은 거래 당사자들의 민사상 합의에 따라 투명하게 진행됐다”고 밝혔다.)

Chung Jeom-sik, the floor leader of the People Power Party, said at a party strategy meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "This is truly outlandish. They vehemently crack down on gap investments as speculation and strictly regulate loans, yet he sold his house on credit." He criticized, "He made billions in profits through an improper trick of bypassing lending rules via private financing." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk wrote on Facebook, "Let's not worry about loans being cut off anymore. Just write 'Joint Mortgage Party' as the source of funds." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에서 “아주 기상천외하다. 갭투자도 투기라고 몰아붙이면서 대출을 철저히 규제하더니 본인은 외상으로 집을 팔았다”며 “사금융으로 대출 규제를 우회하는 편법 꼼수로 막대한 수십억 이익을 본 것”이라고 비판했다. 장동혁 대표는 페이스북에 “이제 대출 안 나온다고 걱정하지 말자. 자금 출처 소명에 ‘더불어근저당’이라고 쓰면 된다”고 썼다.)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, also raised suspicions on Facebook, stating, "Ordinary people have had their bank loans effectively blocked, but someone bought a house with improper private financing. Why did they specifically seek out a buyer with such complicated conditions? Is it an acquaintance?" (이준석 개혁신당 대표도 페이스북에 “일반인은 은행권 대출이 사실상 막혀버렸는데 누구는 편법 사금융으로 집을 샀다”며 “왜 하필 그런 복잡한 조건을 가진 매수자를 찾은 것인가? 지인인가?”라고 의혹을 제기했다.)

In the real estate industry, it's viewed that while a seller deferring the final payment and setting a mortgage is neither illegal nor improper, it's not a typical transaction method. This is because the buyer essentially uses a kind of short-term loan, a type of deal that usually works only with a special relationship between the parties. A real estate expert, who requested anonymity, told *The Hankyoreh*, "It can't be seen as an improper bypass of loan regulations." However, some point out that since large private debts were used for the home purchase in this case, it could be subject to an investigation by the National Tax Service into the source of funds. (부동산 업계에선 주택 매도자가 잔금 수령 시기를 유예해주고 근저당을 설정하는 행위 자체가 불법이나 편법은 아니지만 일반적인 거래 방식은 아니라고 본다. 매수자가 일종의 급전 대출을 이용하는 셈이어서, 거래 상대방이 특별한 관계일 때 성립할 수 있는 거래 방식이라고 보는 게 통상적이기 때문이다. 익명을 요청한 한 부동산 전문가는 한겨레에 “대출 규제를 편법으로 우회한 것이라고 볼 수는 없다”고 말했다. 다만, 이 경우 사인 간의 거액 채무가 주택 매수 자금으로 활용된 것인 만큼 국세청의 자금 출처 조사 대상이 될 수 있다는 지적이 나온다.)

The apartment (exclusive area of 164㎡) in Bundang-gu, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, co-owned by President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, had a sales contract signed on the 14th, with ownership transferred to individuals named Kim and Jo on the 16th. The procedures, including the release of the mortgage, are reportedly expected to be completed by the end of October. (이 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 공동 소유했던 경기 성남시 분당구 아파트(전용면적 164㎡)는 지난 14일 매매 계약이 체결됐고 16일 김아무개씨와 조아무개씨에게로 소유권이 이전됐다. 근저당권 해제를 포함한 관련 절차는 오는 10월 말께 마무리되는 것으로 알려졌다.)

The presidential office stated on the evening of the same day, "The president's home was a single-household residence where the presidential couple lived for 28 years. To show a commitment to normalizing the real estate market, it was sold at below market price, forgoing expected reconstruction profits." It added, "The sale was conducted through a typical method via a real estate agency. The claim that there was a personal connection or special relationship with the buyer is completely unfounded." (청와대는 이날 저녁 “대통령 자택은 대통령 부부가 28년간 실거주했던 1주택으로 부동산 시장 정상화의 의지를 보이고자 시세보다도 낮게 재건축으로 기대되는 이익을 포기하고 처분했다”며 “매매는 통상적 방식으로 부동산을 통해 이뤄졌다. 매수인과 사적 인연이나 특수관계가 있다는 주장은 사실무근”이라고 말했다.)

Reporters: Kim Hae-jung, Choi Jong-hoon sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자, 최종훈 선임기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok's 'Shincheonji intervention in party convention' claims… Jeong Cheong-rae says "false, will take legal action" (김민석 ‘전당대회 신천지 개입설’에…정청래 “허위, 법적 조치할 것”)
item.description:
Allegations of 'Shincheonji intervention' are emerging in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party convention leadership race. Candidate Kim Min-seok has taken the lead in raising suspicions, with Candidate Song Young-gil joining in. Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae has signaled a strong response, stating, "I will take legal action against every single one." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 경선에 ‘신천지 개입설’이 불거지고 있다. 김민석 후보가 주도적으로 의혹을 제기하고 송영길 후보가 가세하면서다. 정청래 후보는 “족족 법적 조처를 하겠다”며 강력한 대응을 예고했다.)

After a 'meeting invited candidates for party leader' held at the Seoul Metropolitan Council in Jung-gu, Seoul on the 21st, Candidate Kim met with reporters and said, "Breaking the triple alliance of 'anti-Myung,' 'factionalism,' and 'Shincheonji' is the essence of this party convention," adding, "I will point out one by one the fact that the 'Shincheonji special counsel' was not pursued." In a radio interview with MBC on the same day, he added, "When I first warned about martial law, everyone said I was crazy and asked what I was talking about. I am also watching the Shincheonji issue very specifically and carefully. I will speak up at appropriate times." However, Candidate Kim did not provide specific evidence. (김 후보는 21일 서울 중구 서울시의회에서 열린 ‘당대표 후보자 초청 간담회’를 마친 뒤 취재진과 만나 “‘반명’ ‘분열주의’ ‘신천지’의 3자 연합을 깨는 것이 이번 전당대회의 본질”이라며 “‘신천지 특검’이 진행되지 않은 점 등을 하나하나 짚어가겠다”고 말했다. 그는 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 인터뷰에서도 “제가 계엄을 처음 경고할 때 다들 정신 나갔다고 뭔 소리냐 이랬는데, 신천지 문제도 아주 구체적이고 주의 깊게 보고 있다”며 “적정한 시기마다 말하겠다”고 덧붙였다. 다만, 김 후보는 구체적인 근거는 내놓지 않았다.)

Candidate Kim's mention of Shincheonji is interpreted as targeting Candidate Jeong. (김 후보의 신천지 언급은 정 후보를 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다.)

On YouTube, videos claiming that Candidate Jeong attended Shincheonji events in the past are circulating, along with assertions that Candidate Jeong, as the party leader at the time, bore significant responsibility for the collapse of the 'Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel' earlier this year. It appears that messages are being sent to party members suggesting that Shincheonji followers are supporting Candidate Jeong to foment division within the ruling camp. An aide to Candidate Kim stated, "During the 2021 Democratic Party presidential primary, circumstances indicating political intervention by a specific religious group were revealed; this is an extension of that issue." (유튜브에서는 정 후보가 과거 신천지 행사에 참석했다고 주장하는 영상과 함께 올해 초 ‘통일교·신천지 특검’이 무산된 배경에는 당시 대표였던 정 후보의 책임이 적지 않다는 주장이 돌고 있다. 신천지 신도들이 정 후보를 지지해 여권 내 분열을 꾀하려 한다는 메시지를 당원들에게 발신한 것으로 보인다. 김 후보 쪽 의원은 “2021년 민주당 대선 경선 당시 특정 종교 집단의 정치 개입 정황이 드러난 바 있는데 그 연장선의 문제 제기”라고 말했다.)

Candidate Song also joined in. On the same day, Candidate Song wrote on Facebook, "I heard a shocking story about the meeting between Shincheonji leader Lee Man-hee and senior member Hong Jun-pyo after the 2021 People Power Party presidential primary. I will cross-check a few things and then talk about it on a broadcast." This suggested an atmosphere that cases of Shincheonji intervening in the People Power Party's internal primary could also occur within the Democratic Party. (송 후보도 가세했다. 송 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “(2021년 국민의힘) 대선 (경선) 후 이만희 (신천지) 교주와 홍준표 선배가 직접 만나 나눈 충격적인 이야기를 들었다. 몇가지 크로스체크를 한 후 방송에서 이야기하도록 하겠다”고 적었다. 신천지가 국민의힘 당내 경선에 개입했던 사례가 민주당에도 있을 수 있다는 분위기를 풍긴 것이다.)

Candidate Jeong responded strongly, calling it "false fabricated information" and "fake news." Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly, he said, "They keep bringing up Shincheonji and pretending as if I am related, but if they get caught, I will take legal action against every single one." (정 후보는 “허위 조작 정보” “가짜뉴스”라며 격한 반응을 보였다. 그는 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “자꾸 신천지 얘기하면서 마치 저하고 관련이 있는 것처럼 연기를 피우는데, 걸리면 족족 다 법적 조치를 하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the claim that he intentionally did not push for the Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel as party leader, Candidate Jeong said, "At the time, we were conducting multiple special counsels, and due to a shortage of dispatched prosecutors, the party, government, and presidential office coordinated to have the joint investigation unit of the prosecution and police handle the case." Regarding the YouTube videos claiming he attended Shincheonji-related events, he said, "It was a district office event where then-Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol also attended and gave a congratulatory speech." Candidate Lee Seong-yoon, a close associate of Candidate Jeong and candidate for the Supreme Council, opposed on Facebook, saying, "Spreading baseless suspicions to sow discord within and foster distrust is a method used only by cults." (정 후보는 당대표 당시 통일교·신천지 특검을 일부러 추진하지 않았다는 주장에 대해서는 “당시 특검을 여러개 하다 보니 파견 검사가 부족하다고 해 검찰·경찰 합동수사본부가 수사하는 걸로 하자고 당·정·청이 조율한 것”이라고 말했다. 신천지 관련 행사에 자신이 참여했다고 하는 유튜브 영상에 대해서는 “구윤철 당시 기획재정부 차관도 참석해 축사도 한 지역구 행사”라고 말했다. 정 후보와 가까운 이성윤 최고위원 후보는 페이스북에 “근거 없는 의혹을 퍼뜨려 내부를 이간질하고, 불신을 조장하여 이득을 보는 건 사이비 종교나 쓰는 방법”이라고 반발했다.)

Amidst this, Candidate Jeong's side announced that after completing a joint campaign speech for party leader candidates at the Democratic Party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul the previous day, the vehicle carrying Candidate Jeong was damaged by an external impact. Candidate Jeong said, "I have requested an investigation by the police." (이런 가운데 정 후보 쪽은 전날 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당사에서 당대표 후보 합동연설회를 마친 뒤 정 후보가 탄 차량이 외부의 가격을 받아 파손됐다고 밝혔다. 정 후보는 “경찰에 수사 의뢰를 했다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party decided that day to reduce the candidate deposits for the party leader and Supreme Council elections by 20 million won each. Rep. Im Ho-seon, the deputy chairman of the party's election management committee, told reporters after the committee's plenary meeting at the National Assembly, "The candidate deposits (combining preliminary and main primaries) were set at 80 million won for party leader candidates and 30 million won for Supreme Council candidates." The deposits for this party convention were originally 100 million won for party leader candidates and 50 million won for Supreme Council candidates. On the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung suggested on X, "If possible, how about considering restoring the deposits to their previous levels?" (한편, 민주당은 이날 당대표·최고위원 선거 후보 기탁금을 각각 2천만원씩 낮추기로 결정했다. 당 선거관리위원회 부위원장인 임호선 의원은 선관위 전체회의를 마친 뒤 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “(예비경선과 본경선을 합한) 후보자 기탁금을 당대표 후보는 8천만원, 최고위원 후보는 3천만원으로 각각 확정했다”고 말했다. 이번 전당대회 기탁금은 당대표 후보가 1억원, 최고위원 후보가 5천만원이었다. 지난 19일 이재명 대통령은 엑스(X)에 “가능하다면 기탁금을 종전 수준으로 되돌리는 걸 고려해보시면 어떨까 한다”고 제안했다.)

Reports by Ko Han-sol, Jeong Hye-min, and Ko Kyung-ju sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 정혜민 고경주 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Repealing Supplementary Investigations Would Be Worst-Case Reform" "Unchecked Prosecutors Are the Real Danger" (“보완수사 폐지 땐 최악 개혁” “통제없는 검사가 진짜 위험”)
item.description:
On the 21st, the Democratic Party of Korea held a policy caucus meeting on the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority to hear expert opinions. Amid rising voices within and outside the party to allow supplementary investigation authority on an exceptional basis following the 'Jang Yun-gi case', experts attending the caucus were sharply divided between support and opposition. <<> Professor Park Chan-woon of Hanyang University Law School, former head of the Advisory Committee of the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office, argued in his presentation that "the core of prosecution reform is not supplementary investigations, and if supplementary investigations are also abolished, prosecution reform will become the worst possible outcome." He expressed concern that "the abolition of supplementary investigations is a product of the anger toward the prosecution that spread after Yoon Seok-youl's impeachment" and "if handled poorly, the abolition of supplementary investigations could lead to a crisis for the Democratic Party administration." <<> In contrast, Professor Yoo Seung-ik of Myongji University (Law) countered the argument that supplementary investigation authority should be partially retained to protect victims, stating, "Victim protection is not a task that can be resolved by relying on prosecutors' charitable goodwill or direct investigation powers." Meanwhile, Professor Hwang Mun-gyu of Joongbu University (Police Administration) proposed an alternative, saying, "To mitigate the side effects of abolishing supplementary investigation authority, we could consider granting complainants, accusers, and victims the right to request a meeting with prosecutors, and giving prosecutors the authority to verify facts." <<> Attorney Kang Dong-pil, a former police officer, said, "Even without prosecutors' supplementary investigations, the police already handle investigative work in practice, so abolishing the authority poses no problem. The real danger is prosecutors' direct investigations without oversight," adding, "If we retain supplementary investigation authority, will prosecutors come to the scene for every single case to look for cable ties, as was problematic in the Jang Yun-gi case?" <<> Attorney Kim Kyu-hyun, a former prosecutor, referred to the Jang Yun-gi case, the Kim Chang-min director case, and the Busan kicking incident, stating, "Supplementary investigation authority is an essential power for investigations related to people's livelihoods. If we just abolish it now, a string of second and third Jang Yun-gi cases will erupt before the general and presidential elections. We must not rush into this fire pit that could cost us the government, like moths to a flame." Kim Hye-jeong, head of the Korea Sexual Violence Relief Center, said regarding the right to demand supplementary investigations, "The 2021 adjustment of investigation authority between police and prosecutors was an extremely difficult change for victims. Claiming everything will work out perfectly is unrealistic. If we must abolish it, there needs to be a process of persuasion." <<> Lawmaker Hong Gi-won, who proposed a bill to exceptionally retain supplementary investigation authority for cases involving socially vulnerable groups, secured an opportunity to speak, saying, "Granting supplementary investigation authority itself is about protecting victims, because no one outside the police can see distortions or mistakes in police investigations." When Professor Hwang Mun-gyu criticized his bill as "revealing an intention for comprehensive re-investigation power," Hong countered, "The bill clearly states that supplementary investigations must be conducted within the scope of the same offense, and if different charges emerge, it requires notifying investigative agencies (police, Serious Crime Investigation Office, etc.) to prevent separate investigations." <<> Meanwhile, the meeting hall, initially filled with lawmakers at the start of the caucus, became sparse as many left during the expert presentations. By the end of the meeting, only about 10 lawmakers remained. The National Assembly will open the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's first subcommittee on bill review on the 22nd to deliberate on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment. <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 21일 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 관한 정책 의원총회를 열어 전문가 의견을 들었다. ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 당 안팎에서 보완수사권을 예외적으로 허용해야 한다는 목소리가 고개를 든 가운데 의총에 참석한 전문가들의 찬반 입장 또한 팽팽히 갈렸다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: “‘New Lee Jae-myung’ Leader Likely President Lee…Prosecution Reform a Total Mess” (유시민 “‘뉴이재명’ 수장은 이 대통령일 가능성…검찰개혁 모든 게 엉망”)
item.description:
Writer Yoo Si-min said on the 21st that he "judged that the leader of the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is likely President Lee Jae-myung." This came as he argued that the 'confusion' that arose during the push for prosecution reform ultimately stemmed from the president's decisions. (유시민 작가가 “(이른바) ‘뉴이재명' 세력의 수장은 이재명 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다”고 21일 말했다. 검찰개혁 추진 과정에서 벌어진 ‘혼선’이 결국 이 대통령의 판단에 따른 것이라는 주장을 하면서다.)

Appearing on the YouTube show '2-Minute News' that day, Yoo criticized the Democratic Party of Korea's process of pushing for prosecution reform—including whether to retain supplementary investigative powers—calling it "misguided in both distinction (of public and private) and priorities, a total mess," and made these remarks. (유 작가는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 보완수사권 존치 여부 등을 둘러싼 더불어민주당의 검찰개혁 추진 과정을 “공사(구분)도, 우선순위도 잘못됐고, 모든 게 엉망이었다”고 비판하며 이같이 말했다.)

He said, "After observing the past six months, I've come to judge that it's not because (the president) had no time or was focused elsewhere. There's a high probability that all of this was orchestrated by the president," adding, "All the actions of 'New Lee Jae-myung' aren't just some riot by the self-proclaimed 'pro-Lee' faction, but something planned and initiated by the president and some aides we don't know well." (그는 “(지난) 6개월을 지켜본 결과, (이 대통령이) 시간이 없어서 또는 다른 데 집중하느라 그런 게 아니고, 이 모든 일은 이 대통령이 기획한 것일 가능성이 많다고 판단하게 됐다”며 “‘뉴이재명’이 하는 모든 행동이 자칭 ‘친명’(친이재명계)들이 벌이는 난동이 아니라 대통령과 우리가 잘 알지 못하는 어떤 참모들이 기획해 시작한 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "I've judged that the leader of the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is not someone like Lee Eon-ju (Democratic Party lawmaker), but likely President Lee himself. I think it's time to speak up now." (그는 이어 “‘뉴이재명' 세력의 수장은 이언주 (민주당 의원) 같은 이런 사람이 아니고 이 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다. 이제는 말을 해야 할거 같다”고 했다.)

'New Lee Jae-myung' was initially a term coined to refer to the new influx of President Lee's supporters after last year's presidential election, but through the conflict phase over the merger between the Democratic Party and the Fatherland Innovation Party, it has come to be used among supporters to denote a faction distinct from the pro-Chung Cheong-rye and pro-Moon Jae-in factions. (‘뉴이재명'은 지난해 대선 이후 새로 유입된 이 대통령 지지층을 뜻하는 용어로 처음 만들어졌으나, 민주당과 조국혁신당의 합당 갈등 국면을 거치며 지지자들 사이에서 친정청래계·친문재인계와 구분되는 이 대통령 지지 세력을 지칭하는 표현으로 사용되고 있다.)

Yoo remarked, "The (amendment to) the Criminal Procedure Act (regarding whether to retain supplementary investigative powers) was supposed to be handled after the local elections. They ended the TF (the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office) activities, saying 'There's no government proposal. We'll leave it to the National Assembly,' and then lawmakers claiming to be pro-Lee introduced strange bills. They even put forward a Criminal Procedure Act amendment inconsistent with the Heavy Crime Investigation Office and the Corruption Investigation Office Act," adding, "Now it's time to see all this as the president's judgment." He further stated, "I can only judge that all of this happens because the president opposes the complete separation of investigation and prosecution. My hypothesis is that (the president) wants to keep the prosecution's investigative powers." (유 작가는 “(보완수사권 존치 여부를 결정할) 형사소송법(개정)은 지방선거가 끝난 뒤 하기로 하고, 티에프(TF·국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단) 활동을 종료하면서 ‘정부안은 없다. 국회에 맡기겠다’ 그래놓고 소위 친명을 자처하는 의원들은 이상한 법안을 냈다. 중수청(중대범죄수사청)·공수청법과 맞지도 않는 형사소송법 개정안을 또 내놨다”며 “이제는 이 모든 것이 대통령의 판단이라고 봐야 할 때가 됐다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이 모든 것들이 다 대통령이 수사·기소의 완전한 분리에 반대하기 때문에 생긴 일이라고밖에 판단할 수밖에 없다. (대통령이) 검찰의 수사권을 남겨놓고 싶어한다는 게 (제) 가설”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Yoo also said, "Absolute power corrupts 100%. No matter how high-quality the fish sold at a fishmonger's, it's bound to smell fishy. If left unchecked with no restrictions, every fishmonger will emit a stench." He added, "If you drive away critics saying 'Don't defame the fishmonger,' 'Are you inciting anti-fishmonger sentiment?' and silence them, eventually a rotten smell will emerge." (유 작가는 또한 “절대 권력은 100% 부패한다”며 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 파는 어물전도 비린내가 나기 마련이고, 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 썩은 내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다. 그는 “‘어물전 명예훼손하지 마’, ‘반(反)어물전 선동하는 것 아니냐’며 비판하는 사람을 쫓아내고 아무 말도 못 하게 하면 결국 썩은 내가 나게 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

By Ko Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: “The Democratic Party Never Even Holds a Discussion on Polarization… Is It Really the Party of the Middle Class and Ordinary People?” (“민주당, 양극화 토론 한번을 안해…중산층·서민의 정당 맞나”)
item.description:
Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention, a debate over “orthodox lineage” has erupted among the party leadership candidates. One might wonder, “This isn’t a monarchy, so why this talk of orthodox lineage?” Yet, in reality, the current Democratic Party does not have many lawmakers who have consistently stood by the party since the days of President Kim Dae-jung’s Peace Democratic Party (PDP). While this is partly a natural change over time, it also reflects the Democratic Party’s tumultuous history of repeated splits and mergers. (더불어민주당의 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 당대표 후보들 사이에서 ‘적통’ 논쟁이 벌어졌다. ‘왕조시대도 아닌데 웬 적통 논쟁인가’ 싶은데, 정작 지금의 민주당엔 김대중 대통령의 평화민주당(평민당) 시절부터 당을 꾸준히 지켜온 의원들이 의외로 많지도 않다. 세월 흐름에 따른 자연스러운 변화이기도 하지만, 분당과 통합을 반복하며 부침이 많았던 민주당의 사정이 반영된 결과이기도 할 것이다.)

Lawmaker Woo Won-shik (five-term) is a living witness to this history of the Democratic Party. After leading a movement to oust former President Chun Doo-hwan and engaging in labor activism in Seoul’s Guro-dong area, he joined the Peace Democratic Party in 1988. Except for a brief period when he was elected Speaker of the 22nd National Assembly and temporarily stepped down from his party affiliation, he has spent 38 years continuously with the Democratic Party. ( 우원식 의원(5선)은 이런 민주당의 역사를 지켜본 산증인이다. 전두환 전 대통령 퇴진 운동을 벌이고 서울 구로동 등에서 노동운동을 하다 1988년 평화민주당에 입당한 그는 22대 국회 전반기 국회의장에 선출돼 잠시 당적을 내려놓은 걸 제외하곤 38년을 줄곧 민주당과 함께 했다. )

Meeting at the National Assembly Members’ Office Building on the 16th, when candidate registration for the Democratic Party’s national convention began, Woo expressed feeling “more frustrated and burdened than ever.” “It’s only been a year since we overcame the life-threatening crisis of an illegal martial law and insurrection with the people, and the Lee Jae-myung administration was established,” yet internal divisions have led to name-calling and talk of a “Myeong-Cheong War” (referring to a power struggle between factions), presenting an image of “internal power struggles.” He said, “I hear people saying that they don’t know who the Democratic Party is for anymore,” adding, “If the people’s disappointment grows and we fail (to regain power), I fear we might never be able to form a democratic government again.” <<> ―The race for the national convention has begun. What kind of image should the candidates show in this convention? <<> “After the impeachment of President Park Geun-hye, the people gave us power, but (due to our shortcomings) we lost it in just five years. Then, through the impeachment of President Yoon Suk-yeol, (the people) gave the Democratic Party another chance, but within a year of taking office, the people’s lives are regressing. Yet, the party is only showing power struggles. Going through the June 3 local elections, I felt ‘the Democratic Party is showing a face far removed from the people’s expectations.’ If the ‘4th Democratic Government’ fails due to internal division... then who would trust the Democratic Party and rally again to create a democratic government in the future? The next time will be truly difficult. This convention must create a very important opportunity for change, with that sense of urgency, to reshape a new Democratic Party that is closer to the people.” <<> ―You recently reminded people via Facebook that the Democratic Party aims to be “the party of the middle class and ordinary people, a national party.” What is the current state of the Democratic Party? <<> “Look at how difficult life is for the middle class and ordinary people now. The delinquency rate for small business owners’ loans has risen by 12%, and the average real estate price in Seoul has surpassed 1 billion won. On one hand, semiconductors are thriving and stock prices have surged, but those gains have not yet reached (the majority of) the people. Rather, the gap is widening, worsening polarization. Yet, I’ve never heard the Democratic Party, a ‘party of the middle class and ordinary people,’ raise polarization as an agenda item. Over the past year, it seems all we’ve done is push for prosecutorial and judicial reform. Also, amid growing concerns about the crisis of local extinction, the government brought forward an agenda for metropolitan integration, but the Democratic Party had no role in it. Even now, candidates running in the national convention talk about ‘what I’ve done in South Jeolla’ or ‘what I’ve done in Gwangju,’ but you rarely hear ‘what I’ve done in Busan or North Gyeongsang.’ That’s because party member votes are all concentrated in the Honam region.” <<> ―Yet, at the convention, the ‘abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers’ seems to be the biggest topic. <<> “The issue of supplementary investigative powers is about how to prevent harm to citizens that could arise from the police’s exclusive exercise of power when prosecutorial investigative powers are abolished, and it’s a matter of providing a clear alternative to reassure the people. But now, this issue has become a campaign strategy for the convention. It’s as if nothing matters unless ‘complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers’ is achieved. Even proposing ‘let’s deliberate on alternatives’ is treated as problematic, which closes off room for dialogue. I’m very worried about how the people might see us.” <<> ―On this issue, even supporters are divided and fighting as ‘Old Democratic Party’ vs. ‘New Lee Jae-myung.’ <<> “During President Kim Dae-jung’s era, many people from the conservative side joined the party. They were given key positions, like National Intelligence Service Director Lee Jong-chan or Presidential Chief of Staff Kim Joong-kwon. They didn’t go anywhere else afterward. They became one with the Democratic Party while realizing their own philosophies. (After the presidential election) New people who joined the party also did so because they agreed with the Democratic Party’s values. So, I don’t understand why we are dividing into factions and constantly trying to split the party internally. We need to consider that President Lee Jae-myung lost once and won once (in the last two presidential elections). Looking at the ‘progressive reform camp vs. conservative reactionary camp’ structure, it’s a difference of just over 1%. Last time, we lost because we were divided; this time, they were divided, so we won. Of course, when bringing in (new figures), we should go through a careful discussion process, but once they are inside, we should discuss differences internally and go through a process of becoming one. But what’s the situation now? Strangely, aren’t we using social media (SNS) to assert our opinions from outside the party, dividing into factions, and engaging in power struggles? If we keep dividing with ‘you’re different from me,’ what will be left? This way, we’ll fail. We’ll never be able to hold power permanently.” <<> ―At the convention, party member sovereignty is being emphasized. The intent seems to be to better reflect the people’s voices in setting the party’s agenda, but there are also criticisms that the party is being overly swayed by the voices of hardline supporters. <<> “Expanding party members’ participation and authority is something a democratic party should naturally do. However, to properly reflect the people’s voices, there needs to be sufficient debate (on issues), but currently, the Democratic Party has no process of deliberation. It’s only about voting. As a result, instead of finding a ‘line’ of agreement, we repeatedly see conflicts and clashes when opinions don’t match.” <<> ―During the convention process, the issue of handling the special counsel bill on fabricated indictments, which grants the authority to withdraw indictments, is likely to become a point of contention. <<> “Illegal issues arising from prosecutorial investigations—whether there were fabrications or coercion—must be clearly revealed through a special counsel to set an example. However, there seems to be significant public disagreement over whether to grant the special counsel the authority to withdraw indictments. That part requires sufficient and careful social discussion. Ultimately, if the fabrication of the indictment is revealed, wouldn’t the court handle it appropriately?” <<> ―Whether to focus on ‘consolidating the core support base’ or ‘expanding the party’s appeal’ is also a key issue at the convention. In particular, it feels like the confrontation is growing larger after writer Yoo Si-min said President Lee Jae-myung’s ‘structural majority’ comment “will inevitably fail.” <<> “I think Yoo might have overexpressed it. He seems to have interpreted the President’s ‘structural majority’ comment as meaning an artificial restructuring of the political landscape (like in the past), but can we actually do an artificial political realignment by allying with people like Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon or Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok right now? After the insurrection, the People Power Party has actually become even more far-right. The President’s comment probably meant that continuing our centrist reformist and pragmatic approach and improving the people’s lives will ultimately lead to forming a majority. Of course, to achieve a structural majority, we must also continue the path of the grand democratic alliance.” <<> ―In the by-election for Pyeongtaek B district in Gyeonggi Province, the Democratic Party fielded a candidate simultaneously with the Rebuilding Korea Party. Hasn’t that made discussions on the grand democratic alliance and the merger of the two parties more difficult? <<> “In the last general election, the broader opposition, including the Democratic Party, secured a maximum of 192 seats. This was possible because we pursued the grand democratic alliance—‘let the party take the local districts and the proportional coalition take the proportional seats’—despite internal opposition. Because of this, we were able to lift the December 3 martial law and impeach (Yoon Suk-yeol). The grand democratic alliance is essential for winning the presidential election as well, and structuring the election in Pyeongtaek B so that both parties field candidates was a huge mistake. Some say it’s because the merger fell through before the election, but the ultimate responsibility lies with the party leader. Regardless, the issue of merging with the Rebuilding Korea Party must fully reflect the will of members from both sides. There are ways to work together: merger, electoral alliance, or policy coalition. We need to listen carefully to the members and choose which method is best. But we must never lose sight of the grand democratic alliance perspective.” <<> <<> ―There’s also criticism that “young people in their 20s and 30s are turning away from the Democratic Party.” <<> “First, diagnosing (the reason) as ‘young people have become conservative’ is wrong. How would you explain the young people in Daegu, a conservative area, who voted for candidate Kim Boo-kyum? Young people have a huge anxiety about the future. Polarization in our society is intensifying recently, and among the youth, the problem is even more severe. Just looking at the asset gap right now, the largest gap between the top 20% and bottom 20% is among the youth. (The fact that young people are leaving the Democratic Party) I see as them raising an issue about this. It’s not just about listening to their voices; we need to present solutions.” <<> ―During the process of setting the convention rules, the introduction of an elected youth supreme council member position fell through. Young candidates in the convention are also criticizing it as ‘vested-interest politics’ and demanding generational change. <<> “Creating a foundation for younger generations to actively engage in the party is important. In that sense, having party members elect a youth supreme council member provides (an important channel for) elevating youth. Defeating that motion really showed the party as a vested-interest party, a truly ‘old-school’ party. It’s truly shameful. However, generational change isn’t unconditionally right. We need to create a framework that can unite the people across old, middle-aged, and young generations. More importantly, the party must decide on its overall line—what efforts it will make to realize a democracy proven through the people’s lives.” <<> ―What direction should the Democratic Party’s line take? <<> “I hear people saying they don’t know who the Democratic Party is for. Some call it ‘the party for wealthy leftists in Gangnam,’ while others say, ‘Looking at the party membership, isn’t it a party for people in their 50s?’ They say this because we haven’t shown our intended direction. We must clarify the party’s line and address youth issues within that framework. The party’s overall line should prioritize people’s livelihoods. In particular, if the current government is focusing on expanding the future pie through economic growth policies aligned with the era of change, like AI technology development, then the party should focus on devising measures to ensure the people are not left behind and can thrive equitably in that process. If we fail to handle these issues properly, polarization could become extremely severe by the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election. The people can only feel at ease if we make overcoming the increasingly severe asset imbalance and polarization a major party line and focus on discussing solutions intensively.” <<> ―While serving as a Democratic Party lawmaker, was there a ‘moment in politics’ where you thought, ‘We handled that well,’ or that this is the direction to keep going? <<> “The moment I was most proud of as a Democratic Party lawmaker was when we created the Euljiro Committee in 2013 and carried out its activities. Politics must be ‘the weapon of the weak.’ That was exactly the slogan of the Euljiro Committee. As soon as I became a supreme council member in 2013, I went to the field, saw the tears of the so-called ‘Eul’s (weaker parties), and to represent their interests, I went around fighting against the ‘Gap’s (stronger parties).’ While balancing (the unfair Gap-Eul relationship), I felt proud, thinking, ‘Ah, this is the Democratic Party I wanted to be a part of.’ In this recent ‘Homeplus crisis,’ Euljiro Committee Chair Min Byung-deog worked very hard. Initially, MBK Partners, the majority shareholder, and Meritz Financial Group, the largest creditor, had no regard for the livelihoods of 100,000 people (including Homeplus workers, tenant businesses, and supplier partners) and were only interested in quickly bankrupting Homeplus to sell its assets. But when the Democratic Party announced it would hold a Homeplus hearing, they finally came up with a solution, didn’t they? The Euljiro Committee’s activities should be made a major party policy and line. Only then will the people think, ‘Ah, democracy improves my life. item.title: Kim Bo-mi: “Democratic Party must stop ‘lineage disputes’ and pursue ‘generational shift in power’” (김보미 “민주당, 족보 논쟁 멈추고 ‘권한의 세대교체’ 해야”)
item.description:
“We need a ‘generational shift in power’ where young people can actually exercise decision-making authority. If we keep digging into lineages, engaging in factional and orthodox lineage disputes, and only talking about the past, the Democratic Party will perish. We must transform into a party with a blueprint for the future.” (“청년이 실제로 결정권을 행사할 수 있는 ‘권한의 세대교체’를 해야 한다. 이대로 족보 캐고 계파·적통 논쟁하며 과거 얘기만 하면 민주당은 망한다. 미래의 설계도를 가진 정당으로 탈바꿈해야 한다.”)

Kim Bo-mi (37), the only candidate in her 30s in the race for party leader in the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention, emphasized ‘generational shift’ and ‘the future’ in an interview with The Hankyoreh on the 21st. Born in Gangjin County, South Jeolla Province, Kim was elected as the first and youngest female county councilor in Gangjin in the 2018 local elections, and after winning reelection in 2022, served as the youngest chair of a local council in the country. ( 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 후보 중 유일한 30대인 김보미(37) 후보는 21일 한겨레와 한 인터뷰에서 ‘세대교체’와 ‘미래’를 강조했다. 전남광주통합특별시 강진군 출신인 김 후보는 2018년 지방선거에서 최초·최연소 여성 강진군의원으로 당선된 뒤 2022년 재선에 성공해 전국 최연소 기초의회 의장을 지냈다.)

– You strongly criticized the party over the ‘scrapped introduction of an elected youth supreme council member system’ and the ‘controversy over raising candidate deposits for the primary.’ ( ―‘선출직 청년 최고위원제 도입 무산’, ‘경선 후보 기탁금 인상 논란’을 두고 당을 강하게 비판했다.)

“Isn’t this the party’s true feelings (toward youth)? So far, they’ve only used (youth) and made them window dressing. The three candidates who have been in politics for a long time and served in leadership (Kim Min-seok, Cheong Cheong-rae, Song Young-gil) say they will introduce a youth supreme council member system if elected, but I can’t trust them. If I become party leader, I will eliminate the deposit barriers and propose the youth supreme council member system as the first agenda item on the day of my inauguration. The constantly changing primary rules are also a problem. I will change this situation where nothing obvious or basic is being observed.” ( “이게 (청년을 향한) 이 당의 진심이 아닐까. 지금까지 (청년을) 이용만 하고 들러리만 세웠다. 정치 오래하고 지도부도 하셨던 세분 후보(김민석·정청래·송영길)가 당선되면 청년 최고위원제 도입하겠다고 하지만 믿을 수가 없다. 내가 당대표가 되면 기탁금 장벽을 없애고, 청년 최고위원제도 취임 당일 안건 1호로 발의할 것이다. 수시로 바뀌는 경선 룰도 문제다. 당연하고 기본적인 게 하나도 지켜지지 않는 상황을 제가 바꾸겠다.”)

– What is the specific vision for ‘generational shift’? ( ―‘세대교체’의 구체적인 그림은 무엇인가?)

“Everyone shouts about youth, but there are no youth in the party. In this era of calling for becoming one of the three major powers in AI, the ruling party should lead future agendas, but if that generation (the 386 generation) goes with a mindset of milking it as 686, 786, 886, 986, it will all fail. A major reform on the level of re-founding the party is needed. The vested interests must step aside, and the party should be newly structured around youth and experts from future generations. (Other candidates) say they’ll set up committees and appoint youth, but what’s the point? They don’t have any power. Instead of just coming up with slogan-driven or handout-based youth policies, we need to actually give young people ‘power.’ When elected, I will ensure that the party’s youth committee has decision-making authority over youth-related policies. A ‘youth employment guarantee system’ should also be introduced as a core party policy.” ( “모두가 청년을 외치지만 당에는 청년이 없다. 에이아이(AI·인공지능) 3대 강국을 외치는 시대에 여당이 미래 의제를 주도해야 하는데, 그 세대(386세대)가 686, 786, 886, 986까지 해먹겠다는 마인드로 가면 다 망한다. 재창당 수준의 대개혁이 있어야 한다. 기득권은 물러나고 청년과 미래 세대 전문가 중심으로 당을 새롭게 짜야 한다. (다른 후보들이) 위원회를 만들어서 청년을 임명하겠다고 하던데 그럼 뭐 하나, 권한이 없는데. 구호성·시혜성 청년정책만 낼 게 아니라 실제로 청년 당사자에게 ‘권한’을 줘야 한다. 당선되면 청년 관련 정책은 당 청년위가 결정권을 갖게 하겠다. ‘청년 취업 보장제’도 당의 핵심 정책으로 도입해야 한다.”)

– The national convention is overheating with disputes over ‘legitimacy’ and ‘personal politics.’ ( ―전당대회가 ‘정통성’, ‘자기 정치’ 논쟁으로 과열되고 있는데.)

“The president is running ahead with future agendas, but we’re not thinking about supporting and advancing them; instead, we’re holding onto the past, ‘digging up lineages,’ and fighting. The urgent issues of our livelihoods matter now, but we’re fussing over who is the orthodox successor. Youth have no interest. Who cares about debates on prosecutorial reform or supplementary investigative powers? The current competition at the national convention is too disconnected from the people’s lives.” ( “대통령은 미래 의제를 갖고 뛰고 있는데, 뒷받침해 나아갈 생각은 안 하고 과거만 붙잡고 ‘족보 캐기’ 하며 싸우고 있다. 당장 우리가 먹고사는 민생 의제가 중요한데, 적통이니 뭐니 하고 있다. 청년들은 관심 없다. 검찰개혁, 보완수사권 논쟁에도 누가 관심 있나. 지금 전당대회 경쟁은 국민의 삶과는 너무 괴리감이 있다.”)

– What is the role of the next ruling party leader? ( ―차기 여당 대표의 역할은?)

“The first duty is naturally the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and building the foundation for regaining power. We must become a ruling party that prepares future agendas one step ahead of the president. We shouldn’t blindly shield the president’s faults. A ruling party that only claps isolates the president. We must listen to the grassroots sentiment and convey it to the president. I will carry on the spirit of Kim Dae-jung and Roh Moo-hyun, who fought against the odds, and the orthodox lineage of that challenge.” ( “제1임무는 당연히 이재명 정부의 성공이고, 재집권의 토대를 만드는 것이다. 미래 의제를 대통령보다 한발 앞서 준비하는 여당이 돼야 한다. 대통령의 잘못을 무조건 감싸서도 안 된다. 박수만 치는 여당은 대통령을 고립시킨다. 바닥 민심을 경청해 대통령에게 전달해야 한다. 계란으로 바위 치기였던 김대중·노무현의 정신, 그 도전의 적통을 잇겠다.”)

– If you are not included in the final three for the main primary, what are your plans afterward? ( ―본경선 최종 3인에 포함되지 않을 경우, 이후 계획은?)

“Local lawmakers are the closest to the people. People speak most comfortably (to local lawmakers). When I convey these very obvious things (by running in the convention), everyone is astonished, but what I’m saying is really conveying the basics of the basics (of public sentiment). (Regardless of the convention outcome) I will persistently practice breaking the rock of vested interests.” ( “지역 의원이야말로 국민들과 가장 가깝다. 국민들이 (지역 의원에게) 가장 편하게 이야기한다. (전당대회에 출마해서 국민들의) 너무나 당연한 이야기들을 전달하는 데 다들 깜짝 놀라시는데, 제가 말하고 있는 건 정말 (민심의) 기본 중의 기본을 전달하는 것이다. (전대 결과와 상관없이) 기득권 바위 깨기를 꾸준히 실천하겠다.”)

Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoon's Office: "New Trump Tariffs Under Section 301 – Industry Minister, Trade Chief to Visit U.S. for Consultations" (청와대 “트럼프 301조 새 관세, 산업장관·통상교섭본부장 미국 방문해 협의”)
item.description:
The presidential office in Seoul stated that regarding the U.S. government's plan to impose new tariffs on dozens of countries, "The Minister of Industry and the Deputy Minister for Trade Negotiations, who will visit the U.S. this week, plan to consult on related matters with the U.S. Department of Commerce and the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR)." (청와대가 수십개국을 상대로 한 미국 정부의 새로운 관세 부과 방침과 관련해 “금주에 방미하는 산업부 장관, 통상교섭본부장이 관련 사항을 미 상무부, 미무역대표부(USTR)와 협의할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

The presidential office made this announcement through a press release on the 22nd. U.S. President Donald Trump's 10% 'global tariff,' imposed under reciprocal tariff policies, is set to expire on the 24th following a ruling by the U.S. Supreme Court that deemed such reciprocal tariffs unlawful. Accordingly, the Trump administration is reportedly preparing a new tariff imposition policy based on Section 301 of the Trade Act. The presidential office added, "The U.S. government has consistently stated its position of respecting the Korea-U.S. tariff agreement," and "As the expiration date of the global tariff imposition on July 24 approaches, the government is closely monitoring relevant developments." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (청와대는 22일 언론 공지를 통해 이렇게 밝혔다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 미국 연방대법원의 상호관세 위법 판결로 그간 부과해온 10% ‘글로벌 관세’가 오는 24일 만료되면서, 무역법 301조에 기반한 새로운 관세 부과 방침을 준비 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 청와대는 “미국 정부는 그동안 한미 관세 합의를 존중하겠다는 입장을 표명해왔다”며 “7월24일로 글로벌 관세 부과 종료 시점이 다가오는 만큼 정부는 관련 동향을 기민하게 파악하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae Recruits 'Youth Fellowship'... President Lee Says "No Fancy Career or Specs Needed" (청와대 ‘청년 펠로우십’ 모집…이 대통령 “거창한 경력·스펙 필요없다”)
item.description:
On the 22nd, President Lee Jae-myung announced the recruitment of the Cheong Wa Dae Youth Fellowship, stating, "We aim to invite you, the youth, not merely as subjects of policy, but as colleagues to ponder together and find answers together." (이재명 대통령이 22일 “청년 여러분을 단지 정책의 대상이 아니라 함께 고민하고 함께 답을 찾아가는 동료로 모시고자 한다”며 청와대 청년 펠로우십을 모집한다고 밝혔다.)

On Facebook that day, the President said, "If a policy affects the lives of youth, its starting point must also be the voices of youth," adding, "While the government is constantly contemplating more delicate and innovative measures, there are clear limitations in capturing all the realities you, the youth, face daily." (이 대통령은 이날 페이스북에 “청년의 삶에 영향을 미치는 정책이라면 그 출발 역시 청년의 목소리여야 한다”며 “정부 또한 더욱 섬세하고 획기적인 방안을 늘 고민하지만, 청년 여러분께서 매일 마주하는 현실을 모두 담아내기에는 분명 한계가 있다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

The President further stated, "A grand career or special specs are not necessary," and "Even a small question felt in daily life is fine, and thoughts like 'I wish it could change this way' are also fine. If you have the desire to create a better world, along with hope and responsibility for the future, that is enough." He added, "We want to see the world through the eyes of youth, talk about policy in the language of youth, and shape the future of the Republic of Korea together based on the experiences of youth," and "We look forward to the keen interest and participation of our youth." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “거창한 경력이나 특별한 스펙은 필요하지 않다”며 “일상에서 느낀 작은 의문도 좋고 ‘이렇게 바뀌면 좋겠다’는 생각도 좋다. 더 좋은 세상을 만들고 싶은 마음, 미래를 향한 희망과 책임감이 있다면 그것만으로 충분하다”고 말했다. 이어 “청년의 시선으로 세상을 바라보고, 청년의 언어로 정책을 이야기하며, 청년의 경험으로 대한민국의 미래를 함께 만들어 가고 싶다”며 “우리 청년 여러분의 많은 관심과 참여를 기대한다”고 덧붙였다.)

The recruitment for the 1st Cheong Wa Dae Youth Fellowship began on the 20th and will run until 6 PM on the 5th of next month. After the announcement of document screening results, the fellows will work from September 1st of this year to February 28th of next year. Eligible applicants are youth aged 19 to 34. (제1기 청와대 청년 펠로우십 모집은 지난 20일 시작돼 다음 달 5일 오후 6시까지 진행된다. 서류심사 결과 발표 등을 거쳐 오는 9월1일부터 내년 2월28일까지 근무하게 된다. 신청 대상은 만 19살 이상 34살 이하 청년이다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
