item.title: Han Byung-do: "Prosecutors Must Investigate Directly to Protect Victims? Looking at the Past, That's Not the Truth" (한병도 “검사가 직접 수사해야 피해자 보호? 과거사 보면 진실 아냐”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and floor leader, said on the 22nd, "The Democratic Party will strengthen the right to request supplementary investigations, and clearly hold investigative agencies accountable to promptly and faithfully fulfill such requests." This signals the party's intention to fully abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority and instead empower the right to request such investigations. (한병도 더불어민주당 당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 “민주당은 보완수사 요구권을 실질화하고, 수사기관이 그 요구를 신속하고 충실하게 이행하도록 책임을 분명히 하겠다”고 22일 말했다. 검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하고 요구권을 실질화하겠다는 방침을 밝힌 것이다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Floor Leader Han stated, "'Prosecutors do not investigate' is both the starting point and the completion of the prosecution reform that separates investigation from indictment. There is no disagreement within the party on this core principle." Han added, "The discussion has sufficiently matured. Now is the time to unite the party's collective will." (한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “‘검사는 수사하지 않는다’는 것이 수사와 기소를 분리하는 검찰개혁의 출발이자 완성이다. 이 대원칙에는 당내 어떠한 이견도 없다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. 한 원내대표는 “논의는 충분히 무르익었다”며 “이제 당의 총의를 하나로 모을 시점”이라고 했다.)

Han further said, "Differences in detailed perceptions should not shake the principle of separating investigation from indictment, nor serve as a means to revive the prosecution's investigative authority. There should only be intense debate to create a better system, such as methods of mutual checks and cooperation among investigative agencies and measures to protect victims." (한 원내대표는 “세부적인 인식의 차이가 수사와 기소의 분리라는 원칙을 흔들거나 검찰의 수사권을 되살리는 수단이 돼선 안 된다”며 “수사기관 간 상호 견제와 협력의 방식, 피해자 보호 대책 등 더 나은 제도를 만들기 위한 치열한 토론만이 있을 뿐”이라고 했다.)

Floor Leader Han remarked, "I have also listened carefully to the argument that supplementary investigation authority is needed to protect victims. I deeply sympathize with the urgent voices that not a single victim should be left behind in the gaps of the system." (한 원내대표는 “피해자 보호를 위해 보완수사권이 필요하다는 주장도 경청했다”며 “단 한 명의 피해자도 제도의 틈에 남겨져선 안 된다는 절박한 목소리에도 깊이 공감한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "That is precisely why victim protection should not be left to the goodwill or discretion of a specific agency. The claim that prosecutors must investigate directly to protect victims is not the truth when we look back at the dark history of the prosecution." (그는 이어 “그렇기에 더더욱 피해자 보호를 특정 기관의 선의나 재량에 맡겨선 안될 것”이라며 “검사가 직접 수사해야만 피해자를 보호할 수 있다는 주장은 지난 검찰의 어두운 과거사를 돌아보면 진실이 아님을 알 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Han stated, "The Democratic Party will strengthen the right to request supplementary investigations and clearly hold investigative agencies accountable to promptly and faithfully fulfill those requests. We will establish mechanisms for control and cooperation that fit the new criminal justice system." (한 원내대표는 “민주당은 보완수사요구권을 실질화하고, 수사기관이 그 요구를 신속하고 충실하게 이행하도록 책임을 분명히 하겠다”며 “새로운 형사사법체계에 맞는 통제와 협력의 장치를 세우겠다”고 했다.)

He added, "We will set up a cross-investigation system where the police and the Major Crimes Investigation Agency check each other, and strengthen investigation reviews and external oversight. We will also more robustly guarantee victims' rights to object, to access records, and to receive legal assistance." (이어 “경찰과 중수청(중대범죄수사청)이 서로를 견제하는 교차수사체계를 세우고 수사심의와 외부 감찰을 강화하겠다. 피해자의 이의신청권과 기록 열람권, 법률 조력을 받을 권리도 더욱 두텁게 보장하겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Koh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok on Yoo Si-min’s "Fish Market Rotten Smell" Comment: "Just Another Intellectual Changing Course" (김민석, 유시민 “어물전 썩은 내” 발언에…“지식인 변침일 뿐”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, countered author Yoo Si-min’s criticism of the ruling party, in which Yoo said, "If you leave a fish market alone, it’s bound to give off a rotten smell," by stating, "In the language of comrades, there are no words like ‘certain defeat’ or ‘rotten smell’." (김민석 더불어민주당 당대표 후보는 유시민 작가가 “어물전 내버려두면 썩은 내 풍기게 돼 있다”며 여권을 비판한 것에 대해 “동지의 언어에 ‘필패’, ‘썩은 내’라는 단어는 없다”고 반박했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, Kim said, "The false prophecies predicting certain defeat for the Lee Jae-myung government will fail this time too, just like their bogus predictions that Kim Dae-jung would fail." He added, "Politics that distorts and manipulates the president’s own voice and intentions, crossing the line of commentary, has even lost restraint and dignity," and dismissed Yoo, saying, "Broadly speaking, he’s just another intellectual changing course, like Kim Ji-ha, Cho Soon, or Lee Nak-yon." <<> Yoo appeared on the YouTube show "2-Minute News" the previous night and, while making remarks suggesting that the internal discord within the ruling camp over the prosecution reform process was due to President Lee Jae-myung, said, "Even the finest fish market selling high-quality fish is bound to smell fishy, and if left unchecked with no limits, every fish market is bound to give off a rotten smell." (김 후보는 22일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “이재명 정부의 필패를 예언하는 헛예언들은 김대중이 실패하리라던 그들의 엉터리 예언처럼 이번에도 필패할 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 김 후보는 그러면서 “대통령의 육성과 진심을 왜곡변조하며 평론의 선을 월경한 정치는 절제와 품격조차 놓았다”며 “(유 작가는) 크게 보면 김지하, 조순, 이낙연처럼 또 하나의 지식인 변침일 뿐”이라고 했다.)

Kim said, "The Democratic Party will prevail on both fronts, inside and outside the party," and addressed Yoo, saying, "We will treat the aggressiveness of a return to politics, stripped of the guise of commentary, as a different political opinion and respect it." He added, "If it serves as a backdrop for the Rebuilding Korea Party to strengthen its independent line, we’ll take that into account as well. The Democratic Party will reorganize itself, replace its leadership, and walk the great path befitting a centrist force for solidarity, integration, and expansion." <<> By Lee Ji-eun, reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (유 작가는 전날 밤 유튜브 방송 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 검찰개혁 추진 과정에서 벌어진 여권 내 혼선이 이재명 대통령 때문이라는 취지의 발언을 하면서 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 파는 어물전도 비린내가 나기 마련이고, 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 썩은 내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea to Skip ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting Again This Year, Likely Burdened by Nuclear and South China Sea Agenda (북, 올해도 아세안 외교장관회의 불참…핵·남중국해 의제에 부담 느낀 듯)
item.description:
North Korea appears set to miss the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF) in Manila, Philippines, for the second consecutive year following last year's absence. <<> On the second day of the ASEAN Regional Forum, July 22 (local time), it was reported that North Korea had not sent a delegation. There were expectations that Hong Kwang-il, North Korea's ambassador to Indonesia and ASEAN, who took office in April, might attend, but it seems the decision was made to skip the event. <<> The background of the absence is interpreted as a consideration that issues to be discussed at the forum, such as the denuclearization of North Korea or matters related to China, conflict with North Korea's stance. <<> The foreign ministers of South Korea, the United States, and Japan are scheduled to hold a meeting in Manila today to discuss strategies for cooperation on North Korea. Each year, South Korea and ASEAN countries release statements through the forum condemning North Korea's nuclear and missile developments and provocations, and urging peace on the Korean Peninsula, which has sometimes sparked backlash from North Korea. <<> Additionally, as the conflict between this year's chair, the Philippines, and China over the South China Sea emerges as a key agenda item at the forum, North Korea, which tends to take a conciliatory stance on China issues, may find it burdensome to express its position on such topics. A diplomatic source stated, "Given that the Philippines is also an ally of the United States, and the focus of the forum could shift to the South China Sea issue, North Korea appears to have decided not to attend based on multiple considerations." <<> Instead, North Korea seems to be focusing on bilateral diplomacy with Russia and China. North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui visited Russia on July 19, two days before the forum opened. Minister Choe paid a courtesy call to President Vladimir Putin and held talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, appearing to focus on strengthening North Korea-Russia cooperation. Meanwhile, with China, North Korea marked the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, with North Korean Premier Pak Thae-song visiting Beijing from July 10 to 12, followed by a return visit to Pyongyang on July 15 by Wang Huning, Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) and fourth-ranking leader in China, continuing high-level exchanges. <<> North Korea, which joined the forum in 2000, began lowering its representation level in 2019 after the second U.S.-North Korea summit, sending ambassadors stationed in the host country or the ASEAN representative office as chief delegates instead of the foreign minister. However, after skipping the forum for the first time last year when it was held in Malaysia, it has now been absent from the consultative body for two consecutive years. <<> Manila / Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (북한이 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF)에 지난해에 이어 올해도 참석하지 않을 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "President Lee Will Not Collect Interest on 1.7 Billion Won Mortgage... Gift Tax to Be Handled" (청와대 “이 대통령, 아파트 17억 근저당 이자 안 받아…증여세 처리할 것”)
item.description:
Regarding the fact that President Lee Jae-myung did not collect interest while setting up a mortgage of 1.77 billion won with the buyer of the apartment he recently sold as the debtor, the Presidential Office stated on the 22nd, "The gift tax issue arising from the interest-free arrangement will be handled in accordance with relevant regulations." This appears to be a measure considering that, under tax law, if no interest is exchanged in financial transactions between third parties, it is considered a gift and may be subject to gift tax. <<> Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong of the Presidential Office appeared on the YouTube program 'Presidential Office Fact Mill' the same day and said, "When the payment of the remaining balance was deferred for several months, the amount became large, so the interest was considerable, but it has been confirmed that the interest will not be collected." In response to criticism from the People Power Party and others, such as Representative Jang Dong-hyuk stating, "Even between parents and children, an interest-free loan is considered an 'abnormal transaction' subject to tax investigation," the Presidential Office reiterated its position. <<> On the 14th, President Lee signed a sales contract for an apartment in Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, and set up a mortgage with a maximum bond amount of 1.77 billion won, designating the buyer as the debtor. According to the Presidential Office's explanation, this was because the buyer temporarily lacked funds to pay the full purchase price, so the payment was deferred for a certain period, and in lieu, a mortgage was established, but no interest was collected on it. <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 최근 매각한 아파트의 매수인을 채무자로 삼아 17억7천만원의 근저당권을 설정하면서 이자를 받지 않은 것에 대해, 청와대가 22일 “무이자에 따라 발생하는 증여세 문제는 관련 규정에 따라 처리될 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 세법상 타인 간 금전 거래에서 이자를 주고받지 않으면 증여로 간주돼 증여세가 과세될 수 있다는 점을 고려한 조처로 보인다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Medical Fees Must Be Rationalized… Strengthen State Responsibility for Public Healthcare" (이 대통령 “의료 수가 합리화해야…공공의료 국가책임 강화”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 22nd that “rationalizing the medical fee system is crucial” to address the gaps in public and essential medical care. (이재명 대통령이 22일 공공·필수의료 공백을 해소하기 위해 “의료 수가체계를 합리화하는 게 중요하다”고 말했다.)

During a ‘Regional, Essential, and Public Healthcare Roundtable’ held at the Blue House, President Lee said, “To expand public healthcare, we must clearly strengthen the responsibility of the national community.” He added, “I’ve come to think whether it’s truly effective to leave everything as a domain for individuals to earn money while demanding morality and public responsibility. We continue to review policies in the direction of strengthening government responsibility for public and essential medical issues.” (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 ‘지역·필수·공공의료 간담회’에서 “공공의료를 확장하려면 국가 공동체의 책임을 확실히 강화해야겠다”며 “개인이 돈을 버는 영역으로 다 남겨두고 거기에 도덕과 공적 책임을 요구하는 게 과연 유효한가라는 생각을 하게 됐다. 공공·필수의료 문제는 정부 책임을 강화하는 방향으로 정책 검토를 계속 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

In this context, President Lee shared a personal experience. (그러면서 이 대통령은 개인 경험을 공유했다.)

President Lee said, “I filed a damages lawsuit against an obstetrician. At that time, the newborn was nearly in a vegetative state, so the compensation amount was enormous.” He continued, “I won the case, but what crossed my mind was that if I had to do everything as per the textbook, it would be impossible with that money. There is a recognized fee schedule, but checking oxygen saturation every five minutes was just not feasible.” He added, “I thought, ‘Who would want to be an obstetrician?’ and eventually, over a decade later, that became reality. Even though I was arguing medical negligence in court, I felt the basic conditions to fulfill the duty of care weren’t in place. It seemed like it wasn’t right. I even thought, shouldn’t the state be the one compensating?” (이 대통령은 “제가 산부인과 의사를 상대로 손해배상 소송을 했는데, 당시 신생아가 거의 식물인간 상태였기 때문에 배상액도 엄청 많았다”며 “재판에서 이기긴 했는데, 그때 든 생각이 교과서에 있는 대로 다 하려면 이 돈으로 도저히 할 수가 없는데, 인정되는 수가가 있는데 5분 단위로 산소포화도 체크하고 할 수가 없었다”고 말했다. 이어 “산부인과 의사 안 하고 싶겠다는 생각이 들었는데, 결국 십수년이 돼서 현실이 되고 말았다”며 “제가 법정에서 의료과실을 주장하고 있긴 하지만, 주의의무를 지키기 위한 기본적 여건이 갖춰져 있나, 이건 아닌 것 같다. 오히려 국가가 배상해야 하는 것 아닌가는 생각을 했다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also addressed the difficulties of reform. He said, “Reform is not easy. You have to adjust existing interests, and such adjustments inevitably involve some parties losing out. In the process of understanding, persuading, and converging to reach a certain conclusion, very rough scenes often unfold.” He added, “However, reaching a certain agreement without doing that—by respectfully adjusting and cooperating—requires everyone’s effort and patience. Although it’s not entirely completed, the progress on issues like medical school quotas and securing public and regional essential medical care is a very desirable achievement.” He further noted, “We often imagine reform involving crying, fighting, noise, confrontation, and conflict. But I think this medical reform process has proven that we can sufficiently reach certain conclusions through dialogue and persuasion without resorting to those things.” (이 대통령은 개혁의 어려움에 대해서도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “개혁이라는 게 쉽지 않다”며 “기존에 있던 이해관계를 조정해야 하고, 이해관계 조정은 필수적으로 뺏기는 측이 있게 된다. 이 점을 서로 잘 이해하고, 설득하고 수렴해 일정한 결론에 이르는 과정에서 대체로 매우 난폭한 모습이 연출된다”고 말했다. 이어 “그러나 그렇게 하지 않고 원만하게 서로를 존중하고 조정하면서 일정한 합의에 이르는 건 모두의 노력과 인내가 필요하다”며 “전체가 완료된 건 아니지만 의대 정원 문제나 공공·지역 필수의료 확보 문제가 상당한 진척을 이루게 된 건 매우 바람직한 성과”라고 덧붙였다. 또 “우리가 개혁하면 울고, 싸우고, 시끄럽고 그 다음에 대결하고 대립하는 것들을 상정하는데, 그러지 않고도 대화와 설득을 통해 충분히 일정한 결론에 이르게 될 수 있다는 점을 이번 의료개혁 과정에서 증명했다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok's 'Shincheonji Interference' Claims... Jeong Cheong-rae Fires Back: "Hit-and-Run Bombing with No Basis" (김민석 ‘신천지 개입설’에…정청래 반격 “아니면 말고식 폭탄던지기”)
item.description:
<<>> Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention for party leader, pushed back against Kim Min-seok's allegations of "Shincheonji interference in the party convention," calling it "a hit-and-run bombing with no basis." ()

After a forum titled "In the Democratic Party, Embracing Youth! Connecting Labor" held at the National Assembly Members' Office Building on the 22nd, Jeong told reporters, "I wish he would present evidence for the Shincheonji interference claim." ( 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당 대표 경선에 출마한 정청래 후보가 김민석 후보가 제기한 ‘신천지 전당대회 개입설’과 관련해 “아니면 말고식, 치고 빠지기식 폭탄 던지기”라며 반발했다.)

Jeong further stated, "Instead of creating smoke screens and later backtracking, he should clearly reveal, based on the five Ws and one H, how Shincheonji is interfering and getting involved in the Democratic Party's convention." ( 정 후보는 22일 국회 의원회관에서 열린 ‘인(in) 민주당 청년을 담다! 노동을 잇다’ 토론회를 마친 뒤 취재진을 만나 “신천지 개입을 근거를 갖고 말했으면 좋겠다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Candidates from Jeong's camp running for the Supreme Council—Lee Seong-yoon, Choi Min-hee, and Han Min-soo—also held a press conference at the National Assembly, demanding Kim reveal his evidence and calling for his withdrawal as a party leader candidate. ( 정 후보는 “연막 피우고 연기 피우고 나중에 발뺌하는 식이 아니라 정확하게 육하원칙에 의해서 신천지가 민주당 전당대회에 어떻게 개입하고 관여하고 있는지 육하원칙에 의해 밝혀달라”고 했다.)

Han said, "Kim's baseless claims are tantamount to saying that the Democratic Party itself should be subject to investigation," adding, "He is dragging our party, which he belongs to, into being labeled as an unconstitutional party violating the separation of church and state, just to gain an advantage in his own election." Lee added, "If he cannot provide evidence, we demand that Kim apologize to the Democratic Party and its members and resign as a party leader candidate." ( 최고위원 선거에 출마한 정 후보 쪽 이성윤·최민희·한민수 후보도 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “근거를 공개하라”며 김 후보의 당대표 후보직 사퇴를 촉구했다. )

Meanwhile, in his meeting with reporters, Jeong claimed, "According to a Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) poll, I have taken the lead in the Honam region by a wide margin," describing it as "the public's expression of opinion against 'you're not it.'" ( 한 후보는 “김 후보의 근거 없는 주장은 민주당 또한 수사 대상이 되어야 한다는 말이나 다름없다”며 “본인 선거에서 유리하자고 자신이 몸담고 있는 우리 당을 헌법상 정교분리를 위반한 위헌 정당으로 몰아가고 있다”고 했다. 이 후보도 “근거를 제시하지 못하면 김 후보는 민주당과 당원들에게 사과하고 당대표 후보를 사퇴할 것을 요구한다”고 했다. )

A KSOI survey conducted on the 20th and 21st via automated response (ARS) among 1,000 adults aged 18 and older nationwide found Jeong at 25.7%, Kim at 21.5%, and Song Young-gil at 8.3% in terms of suitability for the Democratic Party leadership. In the Gwangju and Jeolla region, where about one-third of the party's paid members are concentrated, Jeong scored 34.0%, Kim 23.1%, and Song 18.5%. The survey's margin of error is ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 5.4%. Details are available on the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. ( 한편, 정 후보는 이날 취재진과 만난 자리에서 “한국사회여론연구소(KSOI) 여론 조사상 호남에서 제가 많이 앞서는 거로 역전됐다”며 “‘넌 아니야'에 대한 대중들의 의사 표현”이라고 주장했다. )

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 한국사회여론연구소가 20~21일 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 자동응답(ARS)을 통해 민주당 당대표 적합도를 조사한 결과를 보면, 정 후보 25.7%, 김 후보 21.5%, 송영길 후보 8.3%였다. 민주당 권리당원의 3분의 1가량이 모여있는 광주·전라 지역에선 정 후보가 34.0%, 김 후보가 23.1%, 송 후보가 18.5%였다. 이 여론조사의 표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 응답률은 5.4%다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다. )

item.title: Chung Dong-young "Expects Pope's Visit Next Year to Serve as an Opportunity for Inter-Korean Connection"… Yoo Heung-sik "There Will Be a Role" (정동영 “내년 교황 방한, 남북 연결 계기 기대”…유흥식 “역할 있을 것”)
item.description:
Unification Minister Chung Dong-young met with Cardinal Yoo Heung-sik, Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy of the Holy See, on the 22nd and stated, "The Korean Peninsula has been cut off from contact, dialogue, and meetings for the past 7-8 years. I expect that the Pope's visit to Korea will serve as an opportunity to build a bridge." (정동영 통일부 장관은 22일 교황청 성직자부 장관인 유흥식 추기경을 만나 “한반도가 지난 7~8년 동안 접촉과 대화가, 만남이 끊어져 있는 상황인데 교황께서 (한국에) 오심으로써 그 다리를 놓는 계기가 되리라고 기대한다”고 말했다.)

During a luncheon meeting with Cardinal Yoo at a restaurant in Jung-gu, Seoul, Minister Chung said that just as Pope Francis's visit to Korea in 2014 brought great consolation to a nation suffering from the Sewol Ferry disaster, Pope Leo XIV's visit to Korea next year will be a great blessing for peace on the Korean Peninsula. Pope Leo XIV is scheduled to visit Korea next year on the occasion of the Catholic World Youth Day, which will be held in South Korea in August. (정 장관은 이날 서울 중구 한 식당에서 유 추기경과 오찬간담회를 하면서 2014년 프란치스코 교황이 한국을 방문해 세월호 참사로 고통에 빠진 한국에 큰 위로가 됐듯이 레오 14세 교황의 내년 방한이 한반도 평화의 큰 축복이 될 것이라며 이렇게 말했다. 레오 14세 교황은 내년 8월 한국에서 열리는 천주교 세계청년대회 계기에 방한할 예정이다.)

Minister Chung expressed, "Beyond political significance, I hope that young people from the North can also participate in this gathering of global youth," and added, "I will work hard to restore trust between the two Koreas before the Pope's visit and will do my best to ensure the World Youth Day is successfully held in a positive atmosphere." (정 장관은 “정치적인 의미를 떠나 세계 청소년들이 모이는 데 북쪽의 청소년들도 함께 참석할 수 있게 되기를 소망한다”며 “교황 방한 전까지 열심히 남북 간 신뢰 회복을 위해 노력하고 좋은 분위기 속에 세계청년대회가 성공적으로 되도록 잘 돕겠다”고 말했다.)

Cardinal Yoo explained that Apostolic Nunciatures in various countries operate according to local conditions, including contacting local North Korean embassies in line with the Pope's schedule and messages. He emphasized, "(The Pope) will visit (Korea) from August 3rd to 8th next year. As the Holy See, there will be such roles, and there is no doubt that efforts will be made." (유 추기경은 각국에 있는 교황청대사관이 교황의 일정과 메시지에 따라 현지의 북한대사관과 접촉하는 등 주재 지역의 여건에 맞게 활동을 펼친다고 설명하면서 “(교황께서) 내년 8월3일부터 8일까지 (한국을) 방문하시는데 교황청으로서는 다 그러한 역할이 있을 것이고, 노력하는 것은 틀림없다”고 강조했다.)

At the meeting, Cardinal Yoo shared that when he proposed to Pope Francis several years ago that Korea host the World Youth Day, he cited the division of the Korean Peninsula as the primary reason. He said, "I explained to the Pope that if young people vividly experience division and peace along the 155-mile demilitarized zone (DMZ) armistice line and form a human chain, 300,000 to 350,000 people could connect from east to west." He added, "I told him that it would be tremendously meaningful if young people gathered in Korea, reflecting on the spirit of martyrdom and practicing peace and harmony." Upon hearing this, Pope Francis reportedly said, "Then pray a lot." (이날 간담회에서 유 추기경은 몇 년 전 프란치스코 교황에게 한국에서 세계청년대회를 개최하자고 제안하며 한반도의 분단을 그 첫째 이유로 꼽았다고 소개했다. 그는 “젊은이들이 비무장지대(DMZ) 휴전선 155마일을 따라 분단, 평화를 생생하게 경험하며 인간 띠를 잇는다고 하면, 30만~35만명이면 동에서 서까지 연결할 수 있다고 교황께 설명해 드렸다”며 “젊은이들이 순교 정신을 되새기고 평화와 화합을 실천하며 한국에 모인다면 엄청난 의미가 있다고 말씀드렸다”고 했다. 이 이야기를 들은 프란치스코 교황은 “그러면 기도 많이 하세요”라고 말했다고 한다.)

Cardinal Yoo also mentioned that during a meeting of the College of Cardinals just before his return to Korea, Pope Leo XIV asked whether President Lee Jae-myung enjoyed his visit to the Vatican. Cardinal Yoo replied, "President Lee was very pleased and felt much love (apparently)." The Pope then said he too was "very happy and asked to convey his special regards." (유 추기경은 이번 귀국 직전 참석한 추기경단 회의에서 레오 14세 교황이 이재명 대통령이 바티칸 방문을 좋아했는지를 질문했다면서, 자신이 “이 대통령이 많이 기뻐했고 많은 사랑을 느끼고 갔다(고 한다)”고 답하자 교황도 “아주 기뻤으며 교황의 특별한 인사를 전해달라”고 했다고 전했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Ji-won: "Is Oh Se-hoon Making Jang Dong-hyuk's Dream of a By-election Come True?" (박지원 “장동혁 재선거 꿈, 오세훈이 이뤄주나”)
item.description:
When Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon received a fine of 10 million won in the first trial on the 22nd for suspicions that he received poll results from 'political broker' Myung Tae-kyun and had a supporter pay the cost on his behalf, Park Ji-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, sarcastically remarked, "Mayor Oh is making Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's (of the People Power Party) dream of a by-election come true." If the first trial sentence is finalized, Mayor Oh will lose his position as mayor. (‘정치 브로커’ 명태균씨로부터 여론조사 결과를 받고 그 비용을 후원자에게 대신 내게 한 의혹을 받는 오세훈 서울시장이 22일 1심에서 벌금 1000만원을 선고받자 박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 “장동혁 (국민의힘) 대표의 재선거 꿈을 오 시장이 이루어 준다”고 비꼬았다. 1심 형량이 확정되면 오 시장은 시장직을 잃는다.)

Lawmaker Park wrote on Facebook that day, "Dreams come true. Ironically, Mayor Oh is making Representative Jang's dream of a by-election come true. Mayor Oh, who lied without batting an eye as the mayor of Seoul, the capital of South Korea, home to 10 million citizens! The path to atonement is to give up the appeal, pay the 10 million won fine, and perhaps take a ride on the Han River bus." (박 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “꿈은 이루어진다. 장 대표의 재선거 꿈을 아이러니하게도 오 시장이 이루어 준다”며 “대한민국 수도 1000만 시민의 서울시장으로 눈 하나 깜짝 않고 거짓말한 오 시장! 속죄의 길은 항소 포기하고 1000만원 벌금 납부하고 한강버스나 한번 타보시길 바란다”고 말했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min argued on Facebook that day, "Oh Se-hoon is not qualified to be mayor. There is no place for a lying mayor in Seoul. However, the fine of 10 million won is light compared to the weight of the crime. The appellate court should make a stricter judgment." He added, "The trial deadlines set by the special prosecution law must be strictly observed. The appeal and final appeal should each be concluded within three months. No further delays can be tolerated." (박주민 민주당 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “오세훈은 시장 자격이 없다. 서울에 거짓 시장이 설 자리는 없다”며 “다만, 벌금 1000만원은 죄의 무게에 비해 가볍다. 항소심은 더 엄중히 판단해야 한다”고 주장했다. 이어 “특검법이 정한 재판 기일을 반드시 지켜야 한다”며 “항소심·상고심은 각 3개월 이내다. 더 이상의 지연은 용납될 수 없다”고 했다.)

Park Eun-jung, a lawmaker of the Rebuilding Korea Party, also called for a swift trial. She wrote on Facebook that day, "With today's first trial ruling, a path has opened for citizens to once again judge the reckless administration of Seoul, which had abandoned the safety of citizens threatened by the shoddy construction of the GTX (Great Train Express) and the Han River bus that has turned into a tourist boat." She added, "It is now the turn of Justice Cho Hee-dae's judiciary to respond to the citizens' demands." She further argued, "The Supreme Court should properly confirm Oh Se-hoon's illegal poll cost payment charges as a disqualifying sentence by February next year." <<> Calls for "Immediate resignation of Mayor Oh" also emerged. Lim Myung-hee, spokesperson for the Rebuilding Korea Party, said in a commentary released that day, "Mayor Oh has been claiming his innocence. As a public official serving a fifth term as Seoul mayor, he has been brazenly lying to the entire nation all along." She urged, "Mayor Oh Se-hoon should stop deceiving citizens with meaningless delays and resign immediately. The only remaining duty for Mayor Oh to the people and Seoul citizens is to normalize Seoul's administration as soon as possible." (박은정 조국혁신당 의원도 빠른 재판 진행을 촉구했다. 그는 이날 페이스북에서 “오늘 1심 판결로써 순살 GTX(수도권광역급행철도) 시공과 유람선으로 전락한 한강버스로 위협받는 시민들의 안전을 내팽개치며, 방만했던 서울 시정에 대해 시민들이 다시 심판할 수 있는 길이 열렸다”며 “조희대 사법부가 시민들의 요구에 응답할 차례”라고 했다. 이어 “대법원은 내년 2월 전까지 오세훈의 불법 여론조사 대납 혐의를 당선무효형으로 확정해야 마땅하다”고 주장했다.)

The Criminal Division 22 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Jo Hyeong-woo) sentenced Mayor Oh to a fine of 10 million won on the 22nd for violating the Political Funds Act. Mayor Oh was put on trial for receiving poll results from Mr. Myung a total of 10 times (3 publicly announced, 7 not publicly announced) ahead of the April 7 Seoul mayoral by-election in 2021, and having Kang Cheol-won, former deputy mayor for political affairs of Seoul, arrange for supporter Kim Han-jung to pay around 33 million won in costs on his behalf. The court determined that 21 million won of this constituted the illegal payment of poll costs. (‘오 시장 즉각 사퇴’ 주장도 나왔다. 임명희 조국혁신당 대변인은 이날 낸 논평에서 “그동안 오 시장은 결백을 주장했다. 5선 서울시장이라는 공직자 신분으로 전 국민 앞에서 시종일관 뻔뻔하게 거짓말한 것”이라며 “오세훈 시장은 더 이상 무의미한 시간 끌기로 시민들을 기만하지 말고, 즉각 사퇴하라”고 촉구했다. “하루빨리 서울시정을 정상화하는 것만이, 오 시장이 국민과 서울 시민에게 할 수 있는 마지막 도리”라는 것이다.)

Reporter Jeon Kwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (서울중앙지법 형사22부(재판장 조형우)는 이날 정치자금법 위반 혐의를 받는 오 시장에게 벌금 1000만원을 선고했다. 오 시장은 2021년 4·7 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 명씨로부터 총 10차례(공표 3회·비공표 7회)에 걸쳐 여론조사 결과를 받고, 강철원 전 서울시 정무부시장을 통해 후원자 김한정씨에게 3300만원 상당의 비용을 대신 내게 한 혐의로 재판을 받고 있다. 재판부는 이 중 2100만원이 여론조사 비용 대납에 해당한다고 봤다.)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae on ‘5·18 Sanctuary’: “President Lee Created the Conditions for the Baejae High School Incident” (‘5·18 성역’ 이병태 “배재고 사태, 이 대통령이 원인 제공”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, the former vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Reform who resigned after sparking controversy by claiming that “the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement has become a sanctuary,” has asserted that “President Lee Jae-myung is the one who caused the Baejae High School incident.” (“5·18이 성역이 됐다”는 발언으로 논란을 일으킨 뒤 사퇴한 이병태 전 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 “배재고 사태의 원인 제공자는 이재명 대통령”이라고 주장했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, the former vice-chairman said, “Why did I argue that Gwangju has been turned into a sanctuary? Because people and authorities who seek to monopolize the political symbolism and meaning of certain events—like historical incidents or the Sewol ferry disaster—use it as a marker of partisan politics to stigmatize and character-assassinate their opponents.” (이 전 부위원장은 22일 페이스북에서 “나는 광주가 왜 성역화되었다고 항변했는가”라며 “역사와 세월호 사고 등 특정 사건의 정치적 상징성과 의미를 독점하려는 사람들과 권력이 상대를 낙인찍고 인격 살인하는 진영 정치의 표식으로 삼고 있기 때문”이라고 말했다.)

Pointing to President Lee as the cause of the “Baejae High School incident,” he claimed, “This whole issue started and ended when he, with an irresponsible and conspiratorial perspective, posted a thoughtless comment late at night on social media, framing Starbucks Korea’s marketing as a mockery of unfortunate events from the past democratization process.” (이어 이 대통령을 ‘배재고 사태’의 원인으로 들며 “그가 무책임한 음모론적 시각으로 에스엔에스(SNS)에 스타벅스 코리아 마케팅을 과거 민주화 과정의 불행한 사건들을 조롱하는 것으로 한밤중에 생각 없는 글을 올린 것이 이 문제의 시작이자 전부”라고 주장했다.)

The former vice-chairman added, “This is a case of national conflict sparked by the arrogance of a power-holder who appointed themselves as a judge of history. I conveyed to the (presidential) secretary for national unity that the president should apologize. I don’t know if that message was passed along, but the one who caused it is still playing innocent.” (이 전 부위원장은 “권력자의 역사 심판관을 자처한 오만이 부른 국민 갈등의 사례”라며 “나는 (청와대) 국민통합비서관에게 대통령이 사과해야 한다는 뜻을 전했다. 그 말이 전달되었는지 모르지만 원인 제공자는 지금까지 시치미를 떼고 있다”고 했다.)

He also said, “I will keep asking: Who caused the conflict between Honam and non-Honam regions through partisan politics? Is it Lee Byung-tae or President Lee Jae-myung?” (또 “앞으로도 계속 물을 것이다”라며 “진영 정치로 호남과 비호남의 갈등을 부른 원인 제공을 누가 했는가? 이병태인가 이재명 대통령인가”라고도 했다.)

The former vice-chairman ignited controversy on the 2nd in a Facebook post related to the disciplinary action against students from Seoul’s Baejae High School baseball team for what was called “hateful cheering about May 18.” He claimed that “May 18 has become a sanctuary in this land” and that it was “reminiscent of North Korea.” Despite a warning from the presidential office on the 4th calling his behavior “inappropriate,” he posted again reaffirming his stance. After the presidential office recommended his resignation on the 6th, he stepped down. (이 전 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에 ‘5·18 혐오 응원’으로 서울 배재고 야구부 학생들이 징계를 받은 것과 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 주장해 논란을 빚었다. 이에 청와대가 지난 4일 “부적절한 처신”이라며 경고했음에도 자신의 주장을 고수하는 글을 재차 올렸고, 지난 6일 청와대가 사퇴를 권고하자 물러났다.)

A professor emeritus at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), the former vice-chairman is a conservative figure who served as the head of the policy coordination office for candidate Hong Joon-pyo’s camp during last year’s People Power Party presidential primary. He was appointed in March as vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Reform, a position equivalent to a cabinet minister, under President Lee’s policy of inclusive personnel appointments. (한국과학기술원(KAIST) 명예교수인 이 전 부위원장은 지난해 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 홍준표 후보 캠프 정책총괄본부장을 맡은 보수 출신 인사다. 이 대통령의 통합 인사 기조에 따라 지난 3월 총리급인 규제합리화위 부위원장에 임명된 바 있다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "If 'New Lee Jae-myung' Becomes the Party Mainstream, I Think There Will Be Difficulties in General and Presidential Elections" (정청래 “‘뉴이재명’ 당 주류 되면 총선·대선 어려움 있겠다 생각해”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 22nd, "The so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' should become a plus alpha for the party, but if the major pillar collapses and those people become the party's mainstream, I thought there would be difficulties in many elections ahead." (정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 후보는 22일 “(이른바) ‘뉴이재명’이 (당의) 플러스 알파가 돼야 하는데, 큰 축이 무너지고 그런 분들이 당 주류가 된다면 앞으로 참 많은 선거에서 어려움이 있겠다고 생각했다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on SBS's "Joo Young-jin's News Briefing" that day, Candidate Jeong said, "After the June 3 local elections, I became aware that there is a movement among the Democratic Party's traditional support base and core group to leave en masse. I thought about how we could overcome general and presidential elections without the people who supported Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung sticking together—if the core base turns its back, how is this possible?" He indicated that he decided to run for reelection as party leader, believing that if the 'big pillar' of the traditional support base collapses and the 'New Lee Jae-myung' becomes the mainstream, winning the general and presidential elections would be difficult. <<> When asked about recent remarks by author Yoo Si-min, such as 'the administration is doomed to fail' and 'the leader of New Lee Jae-myung is President Lee,' Candidate Jeong replied, "I'll just say no comment. Sometimes, silence is better." The previous day, on the YouTube channel '2-Minute News,' Yoo criticized the ruling party's prosecutorial reform process as a mess and said, "I judged that the leader of the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is likely President Lee Jae-myung." <<> Regarding his rival for party leadership, Candidate Kim Min-seok's claims of 'Shincheonji involvement,' Jeong said, "Regardless of the pros and cons in the party convention, one should provide exact explanations and, if there is evidence, request an investigation. Doing hit-and-run tactics by talking about vague things, raising suspicions, and passing the buck is unacceptable. If someone mentions my name and links me to such allegations, I will take legal action in the strongest way possible." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (정 후보는 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 주영진의 뉴스브리핑에 출연해 “6·3 지방선거 이후 민주당의 전통적 지지층, 핵심 코어층이 대거 이탈하려고 하는 움직임이 있다는 걸 알게 됐다. 김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명을 지지했던 사람들이 똘똘 뭉치지 않고 어떻게 총선·대선을 넘을 수 있는 것인가, 핵심 코어층이 등을 돌리면 어떻게 이게 가능한가 생각했다”며 이렇게 말했다. 전통적 지지층인 ‘큰 축’이 무너지고, ‘뉴이재명’이 주류가 되면 총선·대선 승리가 어렵다고 보고 당대표 연임에 나섰다는 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee Embarks on 7-Night, 11-Day Diplomatic Tour of US and South America… Series of Meetings with Big Tech CEOs including Jensen Huang (이 대통령, 미국·남미 7박11일 순방…젠슨 황 등 빅테크 CEO 연쇄 회동)
item.description:
The presidential office announced on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung will visit the United States and South American countries including Brazil from the 24th to August 3rd. (이재명 대통령이 24일부터 8월3일까지 미국과 브라질 등 남미를 방문한다고 청와대가 22일 밝혔다.)

National Security Advisor Wi Sung-lac stated at a briefing at the presidential office that day, “President Lee plans to visit San Francisco in the US, Brazil, Chile, and Argentina, and then return via Frankfurt, Germany.” (위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 미국 샌프란시스코, 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나를 방문하고 독일 프랑크푸르트를 거쳐 귀국할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

First, on the 24th in San Francisco, he will sequentially meet with Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, Jensen Huang, CEO of NVIDIA, and Hock Tan, CEO of Broadcom. Afterwards, he will attend the AI Summit and announce the ‘San Francisco AI Declaration,’ expressing the will to leapfrog as an indispensable nation in the global AI ecosystem and outlining a vision for global cooperation. This event will be attended by approximately 150 people, including Lee Jae-yong, Chairman of Samsung Electronics, Chey Tae-won, Chairman of SK Group, along with domestic and international AI business figures, researchers, startups, and investors. On the 25th, he plans to meet with six top venture capital firms to discuss cooperation in the venture ecosystem. <<> Following this, at the invitation of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, he will make a state visit to Brazil from the 26th to the 29th. From the 29th to the 30th, he will officially visit Chile for a summit with President José Antonio Kast, and then make an official visit to Argentina for the first time in 22 years. President Lee is expected to hold a meeting with the Korean community in Frankfurt, Germany on the 2nd of the following month before returning home. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (먼저 24일 샌프란시스코에서 다리오 아모데이 앤트로픽 최고경영자(CEO), 샘 올트먼 오픈에이아이 최고경영자, 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자, 혹 탄 브로드컴 최고경영자를 순차적으로 만날 예정이다. 이후 인공지능(AI) 서밋에 참석해 글로벌 에이아이 생태계에서 대체불가한 대한민국으로의 도약 의지와 글로벌 협력 비전을 밝히는 ‘샌프란시스코 에이아이 선언’을 발표한다. 여기엔 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 최태원 에스케이(SK)그룹 회장 등 국내외 에이아이 기업 관계자와 연구자, 스타트업, 투자자 등 150여명이 참석한다. 25일에는 톱 벤처캐피털 6개사와 만나 벤처 생태계 협력에 대해 논의할 예정이다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae: "Starting Point for Resolving Coupang Issue Differs from U.S.… Must Be Handled Through Law, Not Lobbying" (청 “쿠팡 문제 푸는 출발점, 미국과 차이…로비 아닌 법으로 다뤄야”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae said on the 22nd regarding the Coupang issue, "There appears to be a difference in the starting point for resolving the problem (compared to the U.S.)," adding, "We believe it should be handled fairly and non-discriminately according to legal procedures." (청와대가 22일 쿠팡 문제와 관련해 “문제를 푸는 출발점에서 (미국과) 차이가 있어 보인다”며 “법적 절차에 따라서 비차별적으로 공정하게 다뤄져야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

During a Cheong Wa Dae briefing on the same day, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated, "Among various Korea-U.S. issues, the biggest one is investment, and the next most significant matter can be seen as Coupang," adding, "This matter is being handled according to prescribed regulations and legal procedures. It is not being handled discriminately or targeted." (위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “한미 여러 현안 중 제일 큰 것은 투자고, 그 다음쯤되는 사안이 쿠팡이라고 보면 된다”며 “이 사안은 소정의 규제 및 법적 절차에 따라 다뤄지고 있다. 차별적으로 다루거나 표적해서 다루는 것은 아니다”라고 말했다.)

Director Wi said, "As the Personal Information Protection Commission investigated and announced, this is a major personal information leak, with the scale exceeding 33 million people. However, on the other side, some do not see it as 33 million but, based on what a 'suspect' said, claim it is 3,000 cases," adding, "This is a significant difference, and there is a gap in the starting point." He continued, "If this were the U.S., it would be like the personal information of 200 million people being leaked. If such a leak occurred nationwide and we didn't know where, it would not be a simple matter." (위 실장은 “개인정보보호위원회가 조사하고 발표했듯이 대형 (개인정보) 유출 사안이고, 유출 규모가 3300만명이 넘는다. 그런데 다른 쪽에서는 3300만명이라고 보지 않고 ‘피의자’가 한 얘기에 근거해 3000건으로 얘기하는 사람이 있다”며 “굉장히 큰 차이점이고, 출발점에서 차이가 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “미국으로 치면 2억 인구의 인적 정보가 유출됐다는 건데, 전국에서 유출됐고 (유출된 곳이) 어딘지를 모른다면 단순한 사안은 아니다”라고 했다.)

Director Wi further emphasized, "I believe the most important platform for handling this issue is through prescribed regulations and legal procedures, so it should be addressed there," adding, "If instead, activities like lobbying or other means outside this arena become dominant, it could undermine the proper functioning of existing legal procedures. Therefore, it must be handled fairly and non-discriminately according to legal procedures." (위 실장은 또 “이 문제를 다루는 가장 중요한 장은 소정의 규제와 법적 절차이기 때문에 거기서 다뤄져야 한다고 생각한다”며 “만약 그렇지 않고 장외에서 로비나 다른 방식으로 이뤄지는 일이 주가 되면, 원래 법적으로 존재하는 절차가 온당하지 않게 돌아갈 소지가 있기 때문에 법적 절차에 따라 비차별적으로 공정하게 다뤄져야 한다”고 강조했다.)

On the 1st (local time), the Republican side of the U.S. House Judiciary Committee released an interim investigation report claiming that the South Korean government had discriminately attacked U.S.-owned companies like Coupang, and a White House official also stated, "The Trump administration is deeply concerned about the South Korean government's discriminatory targeting of U.S. technology companies." In response to controversy over Coupang's lobbying activities, Coupang issued a statement on the 16th arguing, "Lobbying activities with the U.S. government and political circles are activities guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution and are the rights of responsible citizens in American society." (지난 1일(현지시각) 미국 하원 법사위원회 공화당 쪽이 한국 정부가 쿠팡 등 미국 소유 기업을 차별적으로 공격해왔다고 주장하는 중간 조사보고서를 공개했고, 미국 백악관 당국자도 “트럼프 행정부는 한국 정부가 미국 기술기업들을 차별적으로 표적 삼는 상황을 깊이 우려하고 있다”는 입장을 냈다. 쿠팡의 로비 활동이 논란이 되자 쿠팡은 지난 16일 입장을 내 “미국 정부와 정치권에 대한 로비 활동은 미국 헌법에 보장된 활동이고, 미국 사회에서 책임감 있는 시민의 권리”라고 주장했다.)

However, Director Wi stated that issues like Coupang do not affect security matters. He said, "Although there are various issues between Korea and the U.S., there are no signs that security consultations are being delayed (due to Coupang, etc.)." He added, "Such situations occurred in the past, but not now. Investment consultations are also being discussed, and I understand efforts are being made to achieve tangible outcomes." (위 실장은 그러나 쿠팡 등의 현안이 안보 현안에 영향을 끼치지 않는다고 밝혔다. 그는 “한미간 여러 현안이 있지만, (쿠팡 등으로) 안보 협의가 지연되는 조짐은 없다”며 “과거에는 그런 일이 있었지만, 지금은 그런 상황이 있지 않다. 투자 협의도 논의되고 있고, 성과물이 가시화되기 위한 노력을 하고 있는 것으로 안다”고 말했다.)

Additionally, regarding U.S. President Donald Trump's request for South Korea to build warships, Director Wi said, "It's not a detailed narrative but rather a few brief points, so it's not clear," adding, "However, there are indications that (Trump) may have in mind a new approach different from what we previously thought, so we are currently assessing it." Earlier last month, President Moon Jae-in revealed at the G7 summit in Évian, France, that President Trump asked, "Can you build 10 U.S. warships quickly?" (아울러 위 실장은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 한국에 군함 건조를 요청한 것과 관련해 “정교한 내러티브라기보다 몇가기 짧게 제시한 것이기 때문에 분명치는 않다”면서도 “기존에 우리가 생각했던 것과는 다른 새로운 방안을 염두에 두는 듯한 정황이 있어 지금 파악 중”이라고 말했다. 앞서 이 대통령은 지난달 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에서 트럼프 대통령이 “미국 군함 10척을 신속히 건조할 수 있느냐”고 물은 사실을 공개한 바 있다.)

Meanwhile, regarding heightened tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, Director Wi said, "There were no new requests (from the U.S. side related to military contributions)." He stated, "South Korea's dependence on crude oil from the Strait of Hormuz is among the highest in the world," adding, "From a security perspective, free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz is not someone else's issue but is directly linked to our security, so we have always participated in discussions with the stance of actively making practical contributions." He continued, "Consultations with the U.S., the U.K., and France have been ongoing," and added, "While there were no specific requests from the U.S. side for warships, we have maintained a position of making practical contributions, and we are working to do so by comprehensively considering domestic legal procedures, legal aspects, and policy considerations."
